source.publisher: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec
source.title: Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec
Part VI — Interstate Status and Progress, Engineering Data, Interstate System
source.note: The table ends at 1997, when the Interstate Construction programme's reporting closed with 42,786.89 of 42,794.49 designated miles open. FHWA states that mileage status data is not available for years before 1960.

mileage.scope: Counts the 42,795-mile system designated under 23 U.S.C. 103(e)(1), (2) and (3), including the toll roads folded in at the start and the unsigned Alaska mileage. It excludes Puerto Rico, and it excludes the Interstate-standard mileage added to the network after the construction programme closed — so it is not the same number as the ~46,900 miles that later editions of Highway Statistics report for the signed Interstate system. Mixing the two series would show growth that is really a change of definition.

events.en: Juan de Oñate's expedition reaches the Río del Norte at the site of Ciudad Juárez, fixing the line of the Camino Real de Tierra Adentro.
events.zh: 胡安·德·奥尼亚特的远征队抵达今华雷斯城一带的北河，内陆皇家大道的走向由此确定。

events.en: The Spanish land at Cape Sandiao and later open a track round the north coast to Tamsui.
events.zh: 西班牙人自三貂角登陆，其后开辟绕北海岸至淡水的通道。

events.en: The Qing lay out a post road north and south from the prefectural city at Tainan.
events.zh: 清廷以台湾府城为中心，建立南北官道。

events.en: The Third Great Western Turnpike — the Cherry Valley Turnpike — is chartered in New York.
events.zh: 纽约州特许设立第三条大西部收费道，即樱桃谷收费道。

events.en: Shen Baozhen's 'open the mountains' campaign brings the first military roads to the foothills.
events.zh: 沈葆桢「开山抚番」，浅山地区开辟最早的军用道路。

events.en: Qing troops cut the Northern Road down the coast from Su'ao after the Mudan incident.
events.zh: 牡丹社事件后，清军自苏澳沿海岸开辟北路。

events.en: Ding Richang and Wu Guangliang open a coast road and settle more than 2,000 people from Shantou.
events.zh: 丁日昌与吴光亮开辟海岸道路，并招汕头潮民二千余人屯垦。

events.en: The Qing coastal road north from Bayao Bay to the Anshuo River, the later Alangyi trail, is opened.
events.zh: 清廷开通自八瑶湾沿海岸北至安朔溪的道路，即日后的阿塱壹古道。

events.en: A stagecoach line begins running from Cañon, now Black Canyon City, to Prescott — a thirty-hour journey.
events.zh: 驿马车线路开始从卡尼翁（今黑峡谷城）通往普雷斯科特，全程三十小时。

events.en: The Mexican Central Railway joins Mexico City to Ciudad Juárez.
events.zh: 墨西哥中央铁路连通墨西哥城与华雷斯城。

events.en: Otto Mears's crews join the two halves of the Silverton–Ouray wagon road on 22 November; it operates as a toll road.
events.zh: 11 月 22 日，奥托·米尔斯的工队把锡尔弗顿至乌雷马车道的两段接通，以收费公路的形式运营。

events.en: A wagon route is established across the crossing SR 20 now uses; it falls out of use within a decade.
events.zh: 在 SR 20 今日所用的越岭线上开辟一条马车道，不到十年即废弃。

events.en: The Army cuts a five-foot pack trail from Valdez toward Eagle.
events.zh: 陆军自瓦尔迪兹向伊格尔方向开辟一条五英尺宽的驮运小道。

events.en: The trail is rebuilt as a wagon road under General Wilds P. Richardson of the Alaska Road Commission.
events.zh: 在阿拉斯加道路委员会的威尔兹·P·理查森将军主持下，小道改建为马车道。

events.en: The Quebec–Miami International Highway is organised along the Atlantic seaboard; it is renamed the Atlantic Highway in 1915.
events.zh: 沿大西洋沿岸组织起「魁北克—迈阿密国际公路」，1915 年改名为大西洋公路。

events.en: A road over the Cuyamaca Mountains east of San Diego is dedicated.
events.zh: 圣迭戈以东翻越库亚马卡山的道路通行。

events.en: The Yellowstone Trail is organised in South Dakota; US 12 will later follow long stretches of it.
events.zh: 黄石小道在南达科他组织成立，US 12 日后将沿用其中大段线路。

events.en: The Lincoln Highway Association is incorporated in Detroit on 1 July, with Henry Joy as president.
events.zh: 7 月 1 日，林肯公路协会在底特律注册成立，亨利·乔伊任会长。

events.en: The California Highway Commission takes over the plank road across the dunes west of Yuma.
events.zh: 加州公路委员会接管尤马以西跨越沙丘的木板路。

events.en: A road between Florida's two coasts is proposed; Tampa's delegate has it extended north and the name Tamiami is coined.
events.zh: 有人提议修建一条连接佛罗里达东西两岸的道路；坦帕代表主张向北延伸，「坦迈阿密」之名由此而来。

events.en: The Old Spanish Trail Association is organised in Mobile, Alabama, to promote a St. Augustine–San Diego highway.
events.zh: 古西班牙之路协会在亚拉巴马州莫比尔成立，推动修建圣奥古斯丁至圣迭戈的公路。

events.en: The Japanese name the 461.7 km gravel road from Keelung to Pingtung the Zongguan Road.
events.zh: 日人将基隆至屏东 461.7 公里碎石路定名为「纵贯道」。

events.en: Texas adopts most of the route as State Highway 3, calling it the Southern National Highway.
events.zh: 得克萨斯把该路线的大部分采纳为 3 号州道，称之为「南方国道」。

events.en: WIS 13 is part of Wisconsin's original numbered state trunk highway system, the first in the country.
events.zh: WIS 13 属于威斯康星最初的州干线公路编号系统，为全美首创。

events.en: The Grand River corridor enters the state trunkline system as M-16.
events.zh: 大河走廊以 M-16 的编号纳入州干线公路系统。

events.en: The Theodore Roosevelt International Highway is organised in February to link Portland, Maine, with Portland, Oregon.
events.zh: 2 月，西奥多·罗斯福国际公路组织成立，旨在连接缅因州波特兰与俄勒冈州波特兰。

events.en: Grading begins on the Carmel–San Simeon Highway north of the Piedra Blanca lighthouse.
events.zh: 卡梅尔—圣西米恩公路在皮德拉布兰卡灯塔以北开始整坡施工。

events.en: The Montana Highway Commission begins the Central Montana Highway over Rogers Pass.
events.zh: 蒙大拿公路委员会开始修建翻越罗杰斯山口的蒙大拿中部公路。

events.en: The Japanese rebuild the trail as the Jiaobanshan–Sanxing road, still a footpath.
events.zh: 日人将步道整修为角板山三星道路，仍为步行道。

events.en: County commissioners ask the State Highway Commission to start the road and build a Current River bridge.
events.zh: 各县委员请求州公路委员会动工并修建卡伦特河大桥。

events.en: The Redwood Highway Association is formed in San Francisco to promote the northern California section to tourists.
events.zh: 红木公路协会在旧金山成立，向游客推广加利福尼亚北段。

events.en: The Ideal Section, a model stretch of road in Lake County, Indiana, is completed.
events.zh: 位于印第安纳州莱克县的示范路段「理想路段」建成。

events.en: NY 28 is designated in the first round of New York state route numbering.
events.zh: NY 28 在纽约州道编号的第一轮中划定。

events.en: An improved state highway along the toll road's alignment is completed.
events.zh: 沿收费公路线位改良的州级公路建成。

events.en: A Zero Milestone is dedicated at San Antonio's City Hall marking the trail's approximate midpoint.
events.zh: 圣安东尼奥市政厅前立起「零里程碑」，标示该路线的大致中点。

events.en: The National Roads Commission is created; in August five survey brigades begin comparing routes to the border.
events.zh: 国家道路委员会成立；8 月，五支勘测队开始比选通往边境的线路。

events.en: The Current River Bridge is completed on 29 July.
events.zh: 7 月 29 日，卡伦特河大桥完工。

events.en: An asphalt road replaces the planks; it later becomes US 80.
events.zh: 沥青路取代木板路，后成为 US 80。

events.en: The Mexico City–Pachuca road opens.
events.zh: 墨西哥城—帕丘卡公路通车。

events.en: The Sinking Creek Bridge is completed on 15 November.
events.zh: 11 月 15 日，沉溪大桥完工。

events.en: The Taitung–Xingang road is widened for motor traffic; the Yoshida bridge at Donghe is rebuilt.
events.zh: 台东至新港段拓宽为汽车道；东河吉田桥重建完成。

events.en: US 1 is numbered on 11 November, taking the coastal route through Maine after a late swap with US 2.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 1 获得编号；在最后阶段与 US 2 对调后，取道缅因州沿海线。

events.en: US 101 is commissioned from the Mexican border at San Ysidro to Olympia, Washington.
events.zh: US 101 编定，自圣伊西德罗的墨西哥边境至华盛顿州奥林匹亚。

events.en: US 11 is approved on 11 November, running from Rouses Point, New York, to a junction with US 90 near the Louisiana line.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 11 获批，自纽约州劳斯波因特至路易斯安那州界附近与 US 90 的交叉口。

events.en: US 12 is approved on 11 November, 1,301 miles from Detroit to Miles City, Montana.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 12 获批，自底特律至蒙大拿州迈尔斯城，全长 1,301 英里。

events.en: US 2 is numbered on 11 November, in two segments separated by Canada.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 2 获得编号，分为被加拿大隔开的两段。

events.en: US 20 is approved on 11 November, from Boston to the east entrance of Yellowstone National Park.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 20 获批，自波士顿至黄石国家公园东口。

events.en: US 30 is approved on 11 November, from Atlantic City, New Jersey, to Astoria, Oregon.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 30 获批，自新泽西州大西洋城至俄勒冈州阿斯托里亚。

events.en: US 395 is created as a spur of US 95, running only from Spokane north to the Canadian border at Laurier.
events.zh: US 395 作为 US 95 的支线设立，仅自斯波坎北上至劳里尔的加拿大边境。

events.en: US 41 is approved on 11 November, from Naples, Florida, to Copper Harbor, Michigan.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 41 获批，自佛罗里达州那不勒斯至密歇根州科珀港。

events.en: US 50 is approved on 11 November, from Sacramento to Annapolis, detouring north through Salt Lake City for want of a road across western Utah.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 50 获批，自萨克拉门托至安纳波利斯；因犹他州西部无路可走，线位北折绕经盐湖城。

events.en: US 550 is designated, running 110 miles from US 50 at Montrose to Durango.
events.zh: US 550 获得编号，自蒙特罗斯的 US 50 至杜兰戈，长 110 英里。

events.en: US 6 is approved on 11 November, running from Provincetown, Massachusetts, to Erie, Pennsylvania.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 6 获批，自马萨诸塞州普罗温斯敦至宾夕法尼亚州伊利。

events.en: After Kentucky's objection, AASHO gives "60" to the Springfield–Virginia Beach route and "66" to the Chicago–Los Angeles road; the system is approved on 11 November.
events.zh: 在肯塔基州提出异议后，AASHO 把「60」给了斯普林菲尔德—弗吉尼亚海滩线，把「66」给了芝加哥—洛杉矶线；11 月 11 日系统获批。

events.en: "62" is proposed for the Chicago–Los Angeles route during the numbering fight, but that road becomes US 66 and the number is left unused.
events.zh: 编号之争期间曾提议把「62」用于芝加哥—洛杉矶线，但该路最终成为 US 66，这一号码就此空置。

events.en: US 64 is approved on 11 November, running from Capulin, New Mexico, to Conway, Arkansas.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 64 获批，自新墨西哥州卡普林至阿肯色州康韦。

events.en: US 70 is approved on 11 November, from Beaufort, North Carolina, to Holbrook, Arizona.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 70 获批，自北卡罗来纳州博福特至亚利桑那州霍尔布鲁克。

events.en: US 83 is created as a short route between Bismarck, North Dakota, and Pierre, South Dakota.
events.zh: US 83 设立，最初是北达科他州俾斯麦至南达科他州皮尔之间的一段短路线。

events.en: US 89 appears in the first federal numbering, at first meaning only the road from Flagstaff to central Utah.
events.zh: US 89 出现在首批联邦编号中，起初仅指弗拉格斯塔夫至犹他州中部的道路。

events.en: The federal numbering makes the eastern half of the trail US 90, from near Orange, Texas, to Van Horn.
events.zh: 联邦编号把这条古道的东半段定为 US 90，自得克萨斯州奥兰治附近至范霍恩。

events.en: US 93 is adopted with the numbering plan on 11 November, running 768 miles from Gateway, Montana, to Wells, Nevada.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日随编号方案获得通过，自蒙大拿州盖特韦至内华达州韦尔斯，长 768 英里。

events.en: US 95 is adopted on 11 November over Idaho's newly finished North and South Highway, a route entirely within one state.
events.zh: 11 月 11 日，US 95 沿刚建成的爱达荷南北公路获得通过，当时完全位于一州境内。

events.en: The Holland Tunnel opens, later becoming the eastern end of I-78.
events.zh: 荷兰隧道通车，后成为 I-78 的东端。

events.en: K-4 is first designated, running from La Crosse east to the Missouri state line near Atchison.
events.zh: K-4 首次划定，自拉克罗斯向东通至阿奇森附近的密苏里州界。

events.en: Nuevo Laredo–Monterrey is complete and opened to tourist traffic; the route through Hidalgo, San Luis Potosí and Tamaulipas is chosen.
events.zh: 新拉雷多—蒙特雷段完工并向游客开放；经伊达尔戈、圣路易斯波托西和塔毛利帕斯的走向确定。

events.en: SH-51 is designated on 1 June in Oklahoma's first generation of state highway numbering.
events.zh: 6 月 1 日，SH-51 在俄克拉何马第一代州道编号中划定。

events.en: Prison labour camps open at Salmon Creek in March and near the Little Sur River in July.
events.zh: 3 月鲑鱼溪、7 月小苏尔河附近先后设立囚犯劳工营地。

events.en: The final alignment across the Sierra Madre between Zimapán and Tamazunchale is fixed.
events.zh: 锡马潘至塔马送查莱之间穿越马德雷山的最终线位敲定。

events.en: Henry Ford's bypass around the Wayside Inn at Sudbury opens on 11 December.
events.zh: 12 月 11 日，亨利·福特出资修建的萨德伯里路边客栈绕行线通车。

events.en: Boy Scouts place the Lincoln Highway's concrete memorial markers along the route on 1 September.
events.zh: 9 月 1 日，童子军沿线埋设林肯公路混凝土纪念标桩。

events.en: The Tamiami Trail opens across the Everglades in April, carrying the number US 94.
events.zh: 4 月，坦迈阿密路横穿大沼泽通车，编号为 US 94。

events.en: Work on the Colonia–Tamazunchale mountain section begins in July.
events.zh: 7 月，科洛尼亚—塔马送查莱山区段开工。

events.en: AASHO splits the route in Tennessee into 11 East and 11 West after towns on the bypassed alignment object.
events.zh: 在被绕开线位上的城镇提出异议后，AASHO 于田纳西州境内将本路线拆为 11 East 与 11 West。

events.en: The Old Spanish Trail Association declares the road complete and dedicates a monument at St. Augustine.
events.zh: 古西班牙之路协会宣布道路建成，并在圣奥古斯丁立碑。

events.en: The Spring Valley Bridge is contracted and built at Round Spring.
events.zh: 斯普林瓦利桥在圆泉签约并建成。

events.en: The renumbering extends the route south into Kingston and north into the Adirondacks, giving it its present C shape.
events.zh: 重新编号将路线向南延伸至金斯敦、向北延伸进入阿迪朗达克，形成今日的 C 形。

events.en: NY 30 is designated in the statewide renumbering.
events.zh: NY 30 在全州重新编号中划定。

events.en: The Japanese finish the coast road from Taitung to Jingpu.
events.zh: 日人完成台东至静浦段海岸公路。

events.en: The Marias Pass road is finished; motorists no longer have to be carried through Glacier by rail.
events.zh: 玛丽亚斯山口公路建成，驾车者不必再靠铁路载运穿过冰川国家公园。

events.en: US 62 is commissioned from Maysville, Kentucky, to Carlsbad, New Mexico.
events.zh: US 62 启用，自肯塔基州梅斯维尔至新墨西哥州卡尔斯巴德。

events.en: The route is extended north to the Canadian border and south through Texas to Brownsville.
events.zh: 本路线北延至加拿大边境，南穿得克萨斯至布朗斯维尔。

events.en: On 12 May a blast at Tamazunchale clears the last large rock; the provisional road is opened to traffic.
events.zh: 5 月 12 日，塔马送查莱的一次爆破清除了最后一块巨石；临时道路开放通行。

events.en: The Middle Road between Toronto and Hamilton begins to be widened as a Depression relief project.
events.zh: 多伦多至汉密尔顿的「中路」作为大萧条救济工程开始加宽。

events.en: AASHO extends the route to Greeley, Colorado, absorbing US 32 in Iowa and US 38 in Nebraska and Colorado.
events.zh: AASHO 将本路线延伸至科罗拉多州格里利，吞并艾奥瓦州的 US 32 与内布拉斯加、科罗拉多两州的 US 38。

events.en: US 60 is extended west from Springfield to Los Angeles on 8 June.
events.zh: 6 月 8 日，US 60 自斯普林菲尔德西延至洛杉矶。

events.en: AASHO extends the southern end to Glendale, Nevada.
events.zh: AASHO 把南端延伸至内华达州格伦代尔。

events.en: The Bixby Creek arch is completed, five years before the highway it was built for.
events.zh: 比克斯比溪拱桥建成，比它所服务的公路早了五年。

events.en: The route is extended west over the former K-52 to its present end north of Scott City.
events.zh: 路线沿原 K-52 向西延伸至今天斯科特城以北的端点。

events.en: Contracts with companies that missed their deadlines are cancelled and the remaining work is let by the piece.
events.zh: 未按期完工公司的合同被解除，剩余工程改为计件发包。

events.en: The Japanese Linhai Road, the future Suhua Highway, opens throughout.
events.zh: 日治时期的临海道路（日后的苏花公路）全线通车。

events.en: Both ends are extended, to Niagara Falls, New York, and El Paso, Texas.
events.zh: 两端分别延伸至纽约州尼亚加拉瀑布城与得克萨斯州埃尔帕索。

events.en: AASHO approves the extension across Tennessee and North Carolina to the coast on 16 June.
events.zh: 6 月 16 日，AASHO 批准横穿田纳西与北卡罗来纳、直抵海岸的延伸段。

events.en: The western end is rerouted to El Paso and the eastern end extended to Atlantic, North Carolina.
events.zh: 西端改道至埃尔帕索，东端延伸至北卡罗来纳州阿特兰提克。

events.en: The Japanese build the Zhongli–Fengyuan army road, the future Zhongfeng Highway.
events.zh: 日人兴建中坜—丰原陆军战备道路，即日后的中丰公路。

events.en: The Bush Highway, the first car route between Mesa and Payson, is completed.
events.zh: 梅萨与佩森之间第一条汽车通道布什公路建成。

events.en: The two convict camps meet on 18 September and the last barrier between San Simeon and Carmel is removed.
events.zh: 9 月 18 日两处囚犯营地施工面会合，圣西米恩与卡梅尔之间最后一道屏障被清除。

events.en: Work on the Xi'an–Lanzhou Highway begins in Xi'an on 23 June.
events.zh: 6 月 23 日，西兰公路在西安开工。

events.en: Thomas McQuesten and Robert Melville Smith rework the plan into a divided, limited-access intercity highway.
events.zh: 托马斯·麦奎斯滕与罗伯特·梅尔维尔·史密斯将方案改为分隔式、有限出入的城际公路。

events.en: AASHTO extends the number south through Oregon, Nevada and California to San Diego.
events.zh: AASHTO 把这个号码经俄勒冈、内华达与加利福尼亚南延至圣迭戈。

events.en: The route is extended through Farmington to Shiprock, New Mexico.
events.zh: 本路线经法明顿延伸至新墨西哥州希普罗克。

events.en: US 59 is added to the numbered system, several years after the original 1926 plan.
events.zh: US 59 加入编号系统，比 1926 年的原始方案晚了数年。

events.en: The Xi'an–Lanzhou earth road opens on 1 May; the Suzhou–Shanghai road, later Cao'an Road, is completed.
events.zh: 5 月 1 日，西兰公路土路通车；苏沪公路（后来的曹安公路）建成。

events.en: By the year's end only the Zhuoshui and Lower Danshui rivers lack a motor-road crossing.
events.zh: 年底时，纵贯道路只剩浊水溪与下淡水溪无法通行汽车。

events.en: The Japanese finish the Hehuan crossing trail from Wushe to Taroko.
events.zh: 日人完成自雾社至太鲁阁的合欢越岭道路。

events.en: The last unpaved link near North Platte, Nebraska, opens on 5 November.
events.zh: 11 月 5 日，内布拉斯加州北普拉特附近最后一段未铺装路通车。

events.en: US 70 reaches downtown Los Angeles, becoming a coast-to-coast route.
events.zh: US 70 抵达洛杉矶市中心，成为横贯两岸的路线。

events.en: The route is extended over the new Boulder Dam and along US 466 to Kingman, Arizona.
events.zh: 本路线经新建成的博尔德坝、沿 US 466 延伸至亚利桑那州金曼。

events.en: The Yellowhead Highway Association is founded to advocate for a northern route across the west.
events.zh: 黄头公路协会成立，倡议开辟一条横贯西部的北线。

events.en: Construction starts on State Route 69 along the Black Canyon alignment; the Depression and the war halt it.
events.zh: 沿黑峡谷线位的 SR 69 动工，随后因大萧条与战争停工。

events.en: The road is inaugurated on 1 July at the international bridge at Nuevo Laredo.
events.zh: 7 月 1 日，公路在新拉雷多国际桥上落成。

events.en: Governor Merriam opens the road at Pfeiffer Park on 27 June.
events.zh: 6 月 27 日，州长梅里亚姆在普费弗公园宣布公路通车。

events.en: The Dihua–Yining road in Xinjiang is finished; from the winter, Soviet aid moves in by road through Khorgas.
events.zh: 新疆迪伊公路建成；当年冬天起，苏联援华物资经霍尔果斯由公路内运。

events.en: The Toronto–Burlington section opens at the end of the year.
events.zh: 年底，多伦多至伯灵顿段通车。

events.en: Extended to Long Beach, California, on 21 June; at 3,652 miles it becomes the longest road in the country.
events.zh: 6 月 21 日延伸至加利福尼亚州长滩；全长 3,652 英里，成为全美最长的公路。

events.en: The Gansu–Xinjiang road is completed at the end of the year, in one account.
events.zh: 据一种记述，甘新公路于年底全路完成。

events.en: Ground is broken on 27 October for a toll highway along the abandoned South Pennsylvania Railroad right-of-way.
events.zh: 10 月 27 日，沿废弃的南宾夕法尼亚铁路路权修建收费公路的工程破土动工。

events.en: The trans-mountain link between Simms and Bonner is completed as a gravel road.
events.zh: 西姆斯与邦纳之间的越山连接以砾石路形式完成。

events.en: The route is first proposed, and construction begins on Highway 2A from Scarborough to Oshawa — the first physical piece of what becomes the 401.
events.zh: 该线路首次被提出；自士嘉堡至奥沙瓦的 2A 号公路开工，成为日后 401 号公路最早建成的一段。

events.en: The Overseas Highway is completed to Key West and becomes the southern extension of US 1.
events.zh: 跨海公路建成通抵基韦斯特，成为 US 1 的南延段。

events.en: ADOT's history puts the completed border-to-border route at 1,600 miles, Nogales to Piegan.
events.zh: 按亚利桑那州交通运输部的记述，这条边境到边境的公路建成时全长 1,600 英里，自诺加莱斯至皮根。

events.en: The Fenggang–Taitung road, begun in 1933 under Japanese rule, is finished for motor traffic. It is today's South Link Highway on PH 9.
events.zh: 日治时期 1933 年动工的枫港台东道完工，可通行汽车，即今台 9 线的南回公路。
events.source: zh.wikipedia, 南迴公路 (历史)

events.en: The route is numbered California Highway 1.
events.zh: 该路线获编号为加利福尼亚 1 号公路。

events.en: The Bureau of Public Roads lists the corridor among proposed national toll superhighways.
events.zh: 公共道路局将该走廊列入拟建的全国收费超级公路之中。

events.en: Arizona Highways reports the Mexico City–Guadalajara road paved and work under way between Guadalajara and the Nayarit boundary; cars can reach only Guaymas in comfort.
events.zh: 《亚利桑那公路》报道，墨西哥城至瓜达拉哈拉道路已铺装，瓜达拉哈拉至纳亚里特州界段正在施工；汽车只能舒适地开到瓜伊马斯。

events.en: The King and Queen unveil the name at the Henley Bridge in St. Catharines on 7 June, for the Niagara segment only.
events.zh: 6 月 7 日，国王与王后在圣凯瑟琳斯亨利桥揭出路名，当时仅指尼亚加拉段。

events.en: The Fenggang–Taitung road, the future South Link, is completed.
events.zh: 枫港至台东道路（日后的南回公路）完成。

events.en: In the general redescription of the Texas highway system, SH 70 runs from east of San Angelo only as far as Dickens.
events.zh: 在得州公路系统整体重新描述中，SH 70 自圣安吉洛以东仅通至迪肯斯。

events.en: SH 71 is redescribed as running only from Bastrop to SH 35, the Austin end having been given over to US 290.
events.zh: SH 71 重新描述为仅自巴斯特罗普通至 SH 35，奥斯汀一端已让给 US 290。

events.en: US 11 is rerouted on 28 June over the newly toll-free Pontchartrain Bridge into New Orleans.
events.zh: 6 月 28 日，US 11 改经刚取消收费的庞恰特雷恩大桥进入新奥尔良。

events.en: The route is fully signed along its whole length to San Diego, five years after designation.
events.zh: 在获得编号五年之后，本路线全长的标志一直竖到圣迭戈。

events.en: The Texas route is truncated at Tenaha and rerouted south and west towards Beeville.
events.zh: 得州段在特纳哈被截短，改向南、向西通往比维尔。

events.en: The Queens–Midtown Tunnel opens, the first piece of what becomes I-495.
events.zh: 皇后区—中城隧道通车，成为日后 I-495 的第一段。

events.en: The Pennsylvania Turnpike opens on 1 October, 160 miles from Irwin to Carlisle — the first long-distance limited-access toll road in the United States.
events.zh: 10 月 1 日，宾夕法尼亚收费公路通车，自欧文至卡莱尔全长 160 英里，是美国第一条长距离限制出入收费公路。

events.en: The Lake Washington floating bridge opens, the first reinforced-concrete floating bridge built anywhere.
events.zh: 华盛顿湖浮桥通车，是世界上首座钢筋混凝土浮桥。

events.en: The name is extended to the whole Toronto–Niagara Falls route on 23 August; fifty-eight kilometres are paved in ten weeks that spring and summer.
events.zh: 8 月 23 日，路名扩及多伦多至尼亚加拉瀑布城全线；当年春夏十周内铺筑五十八公里。

events.en: AASHO approves the extension across Idaho and Oregon to Newport on 3 June, giving US 20 a Pacific terminus.
events.zh: 6 月 3 日 AASHO 批准横穿爱达荷与俄勒冈、直达纽波特的延伸段，US 20 由此获得太平洋端点。

events.en: An extension approved the previous June takes effect, carrying US 95 through Oregon and Nevada to Blythe, California.
events.zh: 上一年 6 月获批的延伸方案生效，US 95 经俄勒冈与内华达延至加利福尼亚州布莱斯。

events.en: Harris County voters approve a bond for the Defense Loop, the ancestor of I-610.
events.zh: 哈里斯县选民通过为「国防环线」发行债券，此即 I-610 的前身。

events.en: The gravel highway between the Dent County line and Eminence is given an aggregate surface.
events.zh: 登特县界至埃米嫩斯之间的砾石路铺设级配碎石面层。

events.en: The route is extended to Fort Erie, bypassing the original Niagara Falls ending, which survives as Highway 420.
events.zh: 线路延伸至伊利堡，绕开原尼亚加拉瀑布城终点，后者留存为 420 号公路。

events.en: The Zhuoshui bridge piers are finished; work stops for want of steel.
events.zh: 浊水溪桥桥墩完工，其后因缺乏钢材停工。

events.en: The southern terminus is moved on 21 October from downtown New Orleans to the US 90 junction in the east of the city.
events.zh: 10 月 21 日，南端点自新奥尔良市中心移至该市东部的 US 90 交叉口。

events.en: Roosevelt approves the project in February; the pioneer road from Dawson Creek to Big Delta is finished in October and opened to Army trucks in November.
events.zh: 2 月罗斯福批准项目；10 月道森克里克至大三角洲的先导路完工，11 月向陆军卡车开放。

events.en: The Willow Run Expressway opens in Michigan to serve a wartime bomber plant, later becoming part of I-94.
events.zh: 威洛兰快速路在密歇根通车，服务战时轰炸机厂，后成为 I-94 的一部分。

events.en: The road south from Nogales is asphalted and called International Highway number 15, by a local history's account.
events.zh: 据一部地方史记载，诺加莱斯南出的道路铺上沥青，并被称为 15 号国际公路。

events.en: Roosevelt approves the route on 11 February and construction begins in March. The pioneer road's last gap closes near Beaver Creek on 25 October, and the highway opens to military traffic at Soldiers Summit on 20 November.
events.zh: 2 月 11 日罗斯福批准该线路，3 月开工。10 月 25 日先导路最后一处缺口在比弗克里克附近合龙，11 月 20 日于士兵岭向军事运输开放。

events.en: Canada and the United States formally name the road the Alaska Highway by exchange of diplomatic notes on 19 July.
events.zh: 7 月 19 日，加美互换外交照会，正式定名为「阿拉斯加公路」。

events.en: The permanent all-weather road is built, linking Dawson Creek and Fairbanks by year's end. Canada and the United States settle on the name Alaska Highway on 19 July.
events.zh: 建成全天候永久道路，年底前贯通道森克里克与费尔班克斯。7 月 19 日，美加两国定名「阿拉斯加公路」。

events.en: Cleveland's Express Highway Plan proposes an Outer Belt East.
events.zh: 克利夫兰《快速公路规划》提出修建东外环。

events.en: Illinois officials begin advocating a route along US 51 between Salem and South Beloit.
events.zh: 伊利诺伊官员开始倡议沿 US 51 修建一条自塞勒姆至南贝洛伊特的路线。

events.en: The Detroit Industrial Expressway is completed, extending the wartime road east into Detroit.
events.zh: 底特律工业快速路建成，将这条战时道路东延入底特律。

events.en: The military road is turned over to Canada on 1 April.
events.zh: 4 月 1 日，这条军用道路移交加拿大。

events.en: Construction begins from Guadalajara towards Nogales, according to Bryan's 1957 study.
events.zh: 据布赖恩 1957 年的研究，瓜达拉哈拉至诺加莱斯段开工。

events.en: The western end is extended from Bonners Ferry, Idaho, to Everett, Washington.
events.zh: 西端自爱达荷州邦纳斯费里延伸至华盛顿州埃弗里特。

events.en: Canada takes over the Canadian portion on 1 April, repaying the United States its construction cost.
events.zh: 4 月 1 日加拿大接管境内路段，并向美国偿付施工费用。

events.en: The corridor is approved as part of the national system of interstate highways.
events.zh: 该走廊获批列入国家州际公路系统。

events.en: The route is extended through Matador, Turkey and Clarendon to Perryton, absorbing the whole of SH 18.
events.zh: 路线经马塔多、特基、克拉伦登延伸至佩里顿，并并入整条 SH 18。

events.en: The Alaska Highway opens to the general public.
events.zh: 阿拉斯加公路向公众开放。

events.en: Planning begins for a freeway along the foot of the San Gabriel Mountains.
events.zh: 沿圣盖博山脚修建高速公路的规划启动。

events.en: Denver begins building the Valley Highway, the oldest part of the route.
events.zh: 丹佛开始修建河谷高速公路，这是本路线最早的一段。

events.en: The first section of the Gulf Freeway opens on 30 September between downtown Houston and Telephone Road — the first freeway built in Texas.
events.zh: 9 月 30 日，海湾快速路首段在休斯敦市中心至电话路之间通车，是得克萨斯州最早建成的高速公路。

events.en: The southern end is transferred to US 277 and the terminus moved to about nine miles north of Bronte.
events.zh: 南端划归 US 277，终点移至布朗特以北约九英里处。

events.en: The highway opens to the general public.
events.zh: 公路向公众开放。

events.en: The Trans-Canada Highway Act is assented to on 10 December. Ottawa will pay half the cost of new construction, up to $150 million in all, and the highway is to be finished by December 1956.
events.zh: 《横加公路法》于 12 月 10 日获御准。联邦承担新建工程费用的一半，总额以 1.5 亿加元为限，公路须于 1956 年 12 月前建成。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1951, p. 633; 1962, p. 783

events.en: Term 32(1) of the Terms of Union obliges Canada to maintain a steamship service to Port aux Basques and, once the road is built, to carry motor vehicles on it.
events.zh: 《联邦条款》第 32(1) 条规定，加拿大须维持通往巴斯克港的轮船航线，并在公路建成后承运汽车。

events.en: AASHO extends US 41 from Naples to Miami in June and deletes US 94 between them.
events.zh: 6 月，AASHO 把 US 41 自那不勒斯延伸至迈阿密，并撤销两地之间的 US 94。

events.en: The eastern end is extended from Annapolis across the Chesapeake by ferry to Ocean City.
events.zh: 东端自安纳波利斯经渡轮跨切萨皮克湾延伸至大洋城。

events.en: By 21 June almost all the signing provinces have federal approval for contracts, and $11.2 million of work has been started.
events.zh: 至 6 月 21 日，已签约的省份几乎都获得了联邦对工程合同的批准，已开工的工程金额达 1,120 万加元。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1951, p. 634

events.en: Ontario, Manitoba, British Columbia, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan and Alberta sign their Trans-Canada agreements at the conference table on 25 April. New Brunswick follows on 27 May and Newfoundland on 23 June. Nova Scotia says it will sign later; Quebec declines.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，安大略、马尼托巴、不列颠哥伦比亚、爱德华王子岛、萨斯喀彻温与艾伯塔在会议桌上签署横加公路协议。新不伦瑞克于 5 月 27 日、纽芬兰于 6 月 23 日相继签署。新斯科舍表示日后再签，魁北克拒签。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1951, p. 633

events.en: Alberta signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 25 April.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，艾伯塔签署横加公路协议。

events.en: A private freight company keeps Thompson Pass plowed through the winter of 1949–50, proving year-round travel possible.
events.zh: 一家私营货运公司在 1949 至 1950 年冬季维持汤普森山口通行，证明全年通车可行。

events.en: British Columbia signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement with Ottawa on 25 April, one of six provinces to sign that day.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，不列颠哥伦比亚与渥太华签署横加公路协议，为当天签署的六省之一。

events.en: Ground is broken at Jinjiguan, Ya'an, on 13 April; the Erlang Mountain section is open to rough traffic on 25 August.
events.zh: 4 月 13 日，在雅安金鸡关破土动工；8 月 25 日，二郎山段初通。

events.en: Manitoba signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 25 April.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，马尼托巴签署横加公路协议。

events.en: The highway is paved between Sinaloa and Nogales, according to Arreola and Madsen.
events.zh: 据阿雷奥拉与马德森的研究，锡那罗亚至诺加莱斯段铺装完成。

events.en: The first Carrera Panamericana starts from Ciudad Juárez on 5 May; the México–Ciudad Juárez road is officially inaugurated on 21 May as part of the Pan-American Highway.
events.zh: 5 月 5 日，第一届泛美公路汽车赛自华雷斯城发车；5 月 21 日，墨西哥城—华雷斯城公路作为泛美公路的一部分正式落成。

events.en: New Brunswick signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 27 May.
events.zh: 5 月 27 日，新不伦瑞克签署横加公路协议。

events.en: Newfoundland signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement with Ottawa in June.
events.zh: 6 月，纽芬兰与渥太华签署横加公路协议。

events.en: Ontario signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement with Ottawa on 25 April.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，安大略与渥太华签署横加公路协议。

events.en: Prince Edward Island signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 25 April.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，爱德华王子岛签署横加公路协议。

events.en: Quebec declines to sign a Trans-Canada Highway agreement while six other provinces sign, holding that it does not sufficiently guarantee the rights of the province.
events.zh: 在其他六省签约之际，魁北克拒签横加公路协议，认为它对本省权利的保障不够充分。

events.en: Saskatchewan signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement with Ottawa on 25 April.
events.zh: 4 月 25 日，萨斯喀彻温与渥太华签署横加公路协议。

events.en: A new road and border crossing north of Lancaster, Minnesota, replace the old northern end at Pembina, North Dakota.
events.zh: 明尼苏达州兰开斯特以北新建道路与口岸，取代原在北达科他州彭比纳的北端点。

events.en: The eastern terminus is extended from Jacksonville to Jacksonville Beach.
events.zh: 东端终点自杰克逊维尔延伸至杰克逊维尔海滩。

events.en: Zhou Enlai approves the design standards of the Kunming–Daluo Highway on 24 January; a management office is set up to build it.
events.zh: 1 月 24 日，周恩来批准昆洛公路测设标准；昆洛公路管理处成立，开始修建。

events.en: Pennsylvania authorises the Delaware River Extension and a joint bridge with New Jersey.
events.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州批准修建特拉华河延伸段及与新泽西共建的大桥。

events.en: The first span of the Delaware Memorial Bridge opens.
events.zh: 特拉华纪念大桥第一座桥通车。

events.en: The first section of what becomes the Atlanta Downtown Connector opens, five years before the Interstate System exists.
events.zh: 后来成为亚特兰大市中心连接线的首段通车，比州际公路系统的设立早五年。

events.en: US 290 is rerouted north and SH 71 is extended from Bastrop back into Austin.
events.zh: US 290 北移改线，SH 71 自巴斯特罗普重新延伸入奥斯汀。

events.en: The first work in the national parks: a bridge over the Bow River near Lake Louise station and about eight miles of grading on the Banff–East Gate section.
events.zh: 国家公园路段首批工程：路易斯湖车站附近的弓河大桥，以及班夫至东门段约八英里的路基工程。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1952-53, p. 768

events.en: The Kunming–Daluo road reaches Yuanjiang in July, Mojiang in August and Pu'er in December.
events.zh: 昆洛公路 7 月通到元江，8 月通到墨江，12 月通到普洱。

events.en: The realigned Black Canyon Highway, lifted out of the canyon onto the mesa, is dedicated in December.
events.zh: 改线后自峡谷移上台地的黑峡谷公路于 12 月举行通车典礼。

events.en: $65 million in bonds is sold and construction begins on 20 November.
events.zh: 发行 6,500 万美元债券，11 月 20 日开工。

events.en: A ceremony on 2 August marks completion to the Galveston Causeway, though much of the southern half still has at-grade intersections.
events.zh: 8 月 2 日的仪式标志道路修至加尔维斯顿堤道，但南半段大部分仍有平面交叉。

events.en: Pennsylvania opens the first section of the Harrisburg–York–Baltimore Expressway, an upgrade of US 111.
events.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州通车哈里斯堡—约克—巴尔的摩快速路首段，由 US 111 改造而成。

events.en: The road is finished on 1 September under Miguel Alemán, according to Spanish Wikipedia.
events.zh: 据西班牙语维基百科，全线于 9 月 1 日在米格尔·阿莱曼任内完工。

events.en: Nova Scotia signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 15 May, the last Atlantic province to do so.
events.zh: 5 月 15 日，新斯科舍签署横加公路协议，为大西洋诸省中最后签署者。

events.en: Three separate existing roads are renumbered 401 and the province begins joining them up.
events.zh: 三条已有的独立道路被重新编号为 401，该省着手把它们连接起来。

events.en: AASHO formally restores the Tennessee 11E/11W split, which the state had never stopped signing.
events.zh: AASHO 正式恢复田纳西州的 11E／11W 分叉——该州从未停止如此标示。

events.en: The Chesapeake Bay Bridge opens and replaces the Sandy Point–Matapeake ferry.
events.zh: 切萨皮克湾大桥通车，取代桑迪角—马塔皮克渡轮。

events.en: The last unpaved section, between Delta, Utah, and Ely, Nevada, is surfaced.
events.zh: 最后一段未铺装路面——犹他州德尔塔至内华达州伊利之间——完成铺装。

events.en: US 183 and US 283 are removed from Junction, Texas, and lose their last junction with their parent route.
events.zh: US 183 与 US 283 被移出得克萨斯州朱恩克申镇，与母号的最后一处交叉由此消失。

events.en: The Department of Public Works forms an Avalanche Research Group to work out how to keep a road open over Rogers Pass.
events.zh: 公共工程部成立雪崩研究组，研究如何让翻越罗杰斯山口的公路保持通行。

events.en: An opening ceremony is held at Jinghong on 16 December.
events.zh: 12 月 16 日，在景洪举行昆洛公路通车典礼。

events.en: Construction begins on the first two segments of the Niagara Thruway.
events.zh: 尼亚加拉收费高速首两段开工。

events.en: Illinois creates a Toll Highway Commission to build the system with bonds rather than taxes.
events.zh: 伊利诺伊州设立收费公路委员会，以债券而非税收修建该系统。

events.en: The Squirrel Hill Tunnel opens, completing the first eight miles of the Parkway.
events.zh: 松鼠山隧道通车，「大道」头八英里贯通。

events.en: The Turner Turnpike between Oklahoma City and Tulsa opens to traffic on 16 May; construction is certified complete that November.
events.zh: 5 月 16 日，连接俄克拉何马城与塔尔萨的特纳收费公路通车；同年 11 月核定竣工。

events.en: The Edsel Ford–Lodge interchange in Detroit opens, the first full freeway-to-freeway interchange in the United States.
events.zh: 底特律埃德塞尔·福特—洛奇立交建成，为美国第一座完整的高速公路对高速公路互通。

events.en: The first section of the Mauka Arterial opens in Honolulu on 9 November.
events.zh: 11 月 9 日，Mauka Arterial 首段在檀香山通车。

events.en: Jalisco's governor, Agustín Yáñez, creates a planning commission for the state's coast, which builds its first tracks and roads.
events.zh: 哈利斯科州州长阿古斯丁·亚涅斯设立该州海岸规划委员会，开始修建海岸最早的便道和道路。

events.en: The Xiluo bridge opens on 28 January, completing the through road; tolls begin the next day.
events.zh: 1 月 28 日西螺大桥通车，纵贯道路全线贯通；次日开始收费。

events.en: The Donghe bridge is rebuilt in concrete.
events.zh: 东河桥改建为混凝土桥。

events.en: The 674 km from Daliyuan to Menghai is complete in December.
events.zh: 12 月，大梨园至勐海 674 公里全部竣工。

events.en: The Qinghai section of the Liuyuan–Golmud road is finished as a basic road in November, by a secondary account.
events.zh: 据二手资料，11 月，柳格公路青海段建成简易公路。

events.en: The Kham–Tibet Highway, Ya'an to Lhasa, opens on 25 December, with the Qinghai–Tibet Highway.
events.zh: 12 月 25 日，康藏公路雅安至拉萨与青藏公路同日通车。

events.en: The extension opens in two stages, reaching Bristol Township in October.
events.zh: 延伸段分两期通车，10 月抵达布里斯托尔镇。

events.en: The triple cantilever opens at Brooklyn Heights, with the Promenade on top.
events.zh: 布鲁克林高地的三层悬臂段通车，顶层为公共步道。

events.en: The West Virginia Turnpike opens — the first 36 miles on 2 September and the rest that November — as a mostly two-lane toll road costing $133 million.
events.zh: 西弗吉尼亚收费公路通车——首段 36 英里于 9 月 2 日开放，其余在当年 11 月——这是一条大体只有两车道、耗资 1.33 亿美元的收费公路。

events.en: Bryan gives this as the year the Guadalajara–Nogales section was completed.
events.zh: 布赖恩将这一年记为瓜达拉哈拉至诺加莱斯段完工之年。

events.en: The Carrera Panamericana is ended by presidential decree after its fifth edition.
events.zh: 泛美公路汽车赛举办五届后被总统令取消。

events.en: A cooperative observer at Rogers Pass records −70 °F, the lowest temperature ever measured in the contiguous United States.
events.zh: 罗杰斯山口的协作观测员记录到华氏零下 70 度，为美国本土四十八州有记录以来最低气温。

events.en: American consultants survey and fix the route.
events.zh: 美国怀特顾问公司踏勘并确定路线。

events.en: The Alaska Highway is designated a National Historic Event on 7 June.
events.zh: 6 月 7 日，阿拉斯加公路被定为国家历史事件。

events.en: The Alaska Road Commission paves the road over Thompson Pass.
events.zh: 阿拉斯加道路委员会完成汤普森山口路段铺装。

events.en: Turnpike bonds are sold in June at 2.93 per cent; construction begins in October with a groundbreaking at Arlington.
events.zh: 6 月以 2.93% 的利率发行收费公路债券；10 月在阿灵顿举行开工典礼。

events.en: The original Tappan Zee Bridge opens, virtually completing the Thruway mainline from Buffalo to the Bronx.
events.zh: 原塔潘齐大桥通车，收费高速自布法罗至布朗克斯的主线几近贯通。

events.en: The Canso Causeway opens, replacing the ferry to Cape Breton Island and putting the designated route on land the whole way to North Sydney.
events.zh: 坎索堤道通车，取代通往布雷顿角岛的渡轮，使指定路线得以全程经陆路抵达北悉尼。

events.en: Work on the Central Cross-Island Highway starts at both ends on 7 July. American aid pays about four fifths of the cost, and more than ten thousand discharged soldiers build it.
events.zh: 7 月 7 日，中部横贯公路东西两端同时开工。美援负担约八成经费，动员一万多名退伍荣民修建。
events.source: zh.wikipedia, 中部橫貫公路

events.en: President Eisenhower signs the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956 on 29 June. It raises the planned system to 41,000 miles, sets nationwide design standards, and fixes the federal share of construction at 90 percent.
events.zh: 艾森豪威尔总统于 6 月 29 日签署《1956 年联邦公路资助法》。该法将系统规划里程提高到 41,000 英里，制定全国统一设计标准，并将联邦承担的建设费用比例定为 90%。
events.source: FHWA, The Dwight D. Eisenhower System of Interstate and Defense Highways, Part I

events.en: Parliament amends the Trans-Canada Highway Act in June. The federal ceiling rises from $150 million to $250 million, Ottawa pays 90 per cent on a tenth of each province's mileage to close the worst gaps, and the completion date moves to 31 December 1960.
events.zh: 6 月，国会修订《横加公路法》：联邦出资上限由 1.5 亿加元提高到 2.5 亿加元；为补上最差的缺口，联邦对各省十分之一的里程承担 90% 费用；完工期限推迟到 1960 年 12 月 31 日。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1959, p. 795

events.en: Work starts in March on a road from Yecheng to Gartok in Ngari.
events.zh: 3 月，叶城至阿里噶大克的公路动工。

events.en: The Black Canyon Highway is completed as SR 69 to Prescott in May; construction of what becomes I-17 begins in earnest.
events.zh: 黑峡谷公路于 5 月以 SR 69 建成通达普雷斯科特；日后成为 I-17 的工程开始实质推进。

events.en: The Federal-Aid Highway Act proposes the route, from Nashville to Chattanooga only.
events.zh: 《联邦补助公路法》提出这条路线，范围仅自纳什维尔至查塔努加。

events.en: The Delaware River bridge opens, linking the Pennsylvania and New Jersey turnpikes.
events.zh: 特拉华河大桥通车，连通宾州与新泽西两条收费高速。

events.en: The route is first proposed, as an alignment for US 181, and appears in San Antonio's expressway plan.
events.zh: 该线路首次以 US 181 线位的形式提出，并出现在圣安东尼奥的快速路规划中。

events.en: The Kentucky Turnpike opens on 1 August between Louisville and Elizabethtown as a bond-financed toll road; it is later absorbed into I-65.
events.zh: 8 月 1 日，以债券融资的肯塔基收费公路在路易斯维尔与伊丽莎白敦之间通车，后被并入 I-65。

events.en: Construction begins on a paving project on US 40 in St. Charles County, Missouri — the first work started anywhere under the 1956 Federal-Aid Highway Act, and now part of I-70.
events.zh: 密苏里州圣查尔斯县 US 40 的一项铺装工程开工，这是依据 1956 年《联邦公路法》在全美最先动工的项目，今属 I-70。

events.en: The Federal-Aid Highway Act converts Ohio's planned second turnpike, State Route 1, into a free Interstate project.
events.zh: 《联邦公路法》把俄亥俄规划中的第二条收费公路——1 号州道——改为免费的州际公路项目。

events.en: Congress incorporates existing turnpikes into the new Interstate System rather than retiring their bonds; the Pennsylvania Turnpike keeps its tolls and gains an Interstate number.
events.zh: 国会将既有收费公路并入新设的州际公路系统，而非赎回其债券；宾夕法尼亚收费公路保留收费，并获得州际公路编号。

events.en: The New Jersey Turnpike's Newark Bay Extension opens, carrying I-78 to the tunnel approaches.
events.zh: 新泽西收费高速纽瓦克湾延伸线通车，承载 I-78 通往隧道引道。

events.en: The final section of the Toronto Bypass opens on 24 August.
events.zh: 8 月 24 日，多伦多绕城线最后一段通车。

events.en: Four lanes of pavement are completed all the way to Fort Erie.
events.zh: 四车道路面全线铺至伊利堡。

events.en: Penetration asphalt surfacing from Taoyuan to Tainan, begun in 1952, is completed.
events.zh: 1952 年开始的桃园至台南灌入式沥青路面工程完成。

events.en: Ground is broken at both ends on 7 July; more than 10,000 retired servicemen are put to work.
events.zh: 7 月 7 日东西两端同时开工，动员退伍荣民一万多人。

events.en: AASHO adopts the numbering plan still in use: even numbers run east–west and odd numbers north–south, both rising from the south and west, with three digits marking a loop or spur off a parent route.
events.zh: 美国州公路工作者协会通过沿用至今的编号规则：偶数为东西向、奇数为南北向，编号均自南向北、自西向东递增；三位数则表示由主线派生的环线或支线。
events.source: AASHTO / FHWA highway history

events.en: The highway is hard-surfaced.
events.zh: 公路完成硬化路面施工。

events.en: The Xinjiang–Tibet Highway, 1,179 km, opens on 6 October.
events.zh: 10 月 6 日，全长 1179 公里的新藏公路通车。

events.en: Work starts on the southern line through Yajiang, Litang and Batang, today's G318.
events.zh: 经雅江、理塘、巴塘的南线（今 G318）开始修筑。

events.en: I-10 is numbered in the first Interstate numbering, from Santa Monica to Jacksonville.
events.zh: 州际公路首次编号，I-10 获得编号，自圣莫尼卡至杰克逊维尔。

events.en: I-12 is added to the Interstate System on 17 October, running from I-10 at Baton Rouge to I-59 north of Slidell.
events.zh: 10 月 17 日，I-12 被列入州际公路系统，自巴吞鲁日的 I-10 通往斯莱德尔以北的 I-59。

events.en: I-15 is numbered in the first Interstate numbering.
events.zh: 州际公路首次编号，I-15 获得编号。

events.en: The route is designated in the first round of Interstate numbering.
events.zh: 本路线在首轮州际公路编号中确定。

events.en: Missouri begins soil work at the Pigeon Creek bridge site south of St Joseph.
events.zh: 密苏里在圣约瑟夫以南的鸽溪桥址开始土方作业。

events.en: The Dallas–Fort Worth Turnpike opens on 27 August.
events.zh: 达拉斯—沃思堡收费公路于 8 月 27 日通车。

events.en: The San Antonio–Corpus Christi corridor is added to the national Interstate system.
events.zh: 圣安东尼奥—科珀斯克里斯蒂走廊纳入国家州际公路系统。

events.en: I-40 is numbered in the first Interstate numbering, from Barstow to Greensboro.
events.zh: 州际公路首次编号，I-40 获得编号，自巴斯托至格林斯伯勒。

events.en: The Will Rogers Turnpike opens on 18 June, carrying the corridor from Tulsa to the Missouri state line.
events.zh: 6 月 18 日威尔·罗杰斯收费公路通车，把走廊从塔尔萨延伸至密苏里州界。

events.en: The number I-5 is applied in the first Interstate numbering, and the Westside Freeway relocation is approved.
events.zh: 州际公路首次编号确定 I-5 编号，西侧高速公路改线方案同期获批。

events.en: A 64.7-mile stretch of US 51 from New Orleans to McComb is designated for the Interstate System in July; the number I-55 is assigned on 14 August.
events.zh: 7 月，自新奥尔良至麦库姆的 64.7 英里 US 51 路段被指定纳入州际公路系统；8 月 14 日确定编号 I-55。

events.en: The first two-lane Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel opens on 1 November, years before I-64 reaches it.
events.zh: 11 月 1 日，第一条双车道汉普顿锚地桥隧通车，比 I-64 修抵此处早了许多年。

events.en: I-66 is added to the Interstate System on 14 August.
events.zh: 8 月 14 日，I-66 被纳入州际公路系统。

events.en: The Bureau of Public Roads extends I-70 west of Denver and announces Cove Fort, Utah, as its terminus, overriding Utah's preference for Spanish Fork.
events.zh: 公共道路局将 I-70 西延至丹佛以西，并宣布终点为犹他州考夫堡，否决了犹他州倾向的西班牙福克方案。

events.en: AASHO releases the preliminary Interstate numbering plan for Illinois, with I-74 running from Moline southeast to the Indiana line.
events.zh: AASHO 公布伊利诺伊州际公路初步编号方案，I-74 自莫林东南行至印第安纳州界。

events.en: The Mackinac Bridge opens across the Straits of Mackinac, later carrying I-75 between Michigan's peninsulas.
events.zh: 麦基诺大桥跨越麦基诺海峡通车，后来成为 I-75 连接密歇根上下半岛的通道。

events.en: I-80 is numbered in the first plan for the Interstate System.
events.zh: 州际公路系统首个编号方案中，I-80 获得编号。

events.en: I-81 is numbered in the first plan for the Interstate System, following the US 11 corridor.
events.zh: 州际公路系统首个编号方案中，I-81 获得编号，循 US 11 走廊而行。

events.en: I-85 is designated in August as a route from Montgomery, Alabama to Petersburg, Virginia.
events.zh: 8 月，I-85 定名，路线自亚拉巴马州蒙哥马利至弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡。

events.en: I-87 is assigned, and construction of the Adirondack Northway begins at Albany.
events.zh: I-87 定名，阿迪朗达克北路自奥尔巴尼开工。

events.en: The double-deck Cypress Street Viaduct opens through West Oakland.
events.zh: 双层的柏树街高架桥在西奥克兰通车。

events.en: I-90 is numbered in the first plan for the Interstate System.
events.zh: 州际公路系统首个编号方案中，I-90 获得编号。

events.en: I-95 is assigned in the first numbering of the Interstate System.
events.zh: 州际公路系统首次编号，I-95 获得编号。

events.en: A four-mile piece of the Brighton–Farmington Expressway opens on 1 August, the first funded Interstate section to open in Michigan.
events.zh: 8 月 1 日，布赖顿—法明顿快速路的四英里路段通车，为密歇根州第一段获联邦资金的州际公路通车路段。

events.en: Saskatchewan becomes the first province to complete its 654 km section, and the highway there is opened and dedicated on 21 August.
events.zh: 萨斯喀彻温成为第一个建成本省 654 公里路段的省份，8 月 21 日该段通车并举行落成仪式。

events.en: The engineer Jin Heng is killed by rockfall in October, the first death on the job.
events.zh: 10 月，工程师靳珩遭地震落石击落山谷，为第一位殉职者。

events.en: The first Interstate Cost Estimate submitted to Congress puts the price of the system at $37.6 billion, of which $34.0 billion would be federal. Fourteen more estimates follow over the next 33 years.
events.zh: 首份《州际公路造价估算》提交国会，估计系统造价 376 亿美元，其中联邦承担 340 亿美元。此后 33 年间又提交了十四份估算。
events.source: FHWA, Interstate System cost estimates reported to Congress, 1958–1991

events.en: The Canadian Automobile Association installs the Mile 0 monument at Beacon Hill Park in Victoria — four years before the highway opens.
events.zh: 加拿大汽车协会在维多利亚灯塔山公园立起零英里纪念碑，比公路通车早了四年。

events.en: The Valley Highway in Denver is fully open.
events.zh: 丹佛河谷高速公路全线通车。

events.en: Construction starts in northern Hamilton County, Ohio.
events.zh: 工程在俄亥俄州汉密尔顿县北部开工。

events.en: The first I-285 contract is let for 2.5 miles in DeKalb County.
events.zh: I-285 首份合同发出，工程为迪卡尔布县的 2.5 英里路段。

events.en: Construction begins in Somerset County, New Jersey.
events.zh: 工程在新泽西州萨默塞特县开工。

events.en: The first segments open near Council Bluffs and Sioux City, and at Sioux Falls in South Dakota.
events.zh: 首批路段在康瑟尔布拉夫斯、苏城一带及南达科他州苏福尔斯通车。

events.en: The Tri-State Tollway opens in sections, the last on 23 December.
events.zh: 三州收费高速分段通车，最后一段于 12 月 23 日开放。

events.en: The corridor receives the I-295 designation in New Jersey.
events.zh: 该走廊在新泽西州获得 I-295 编号。

events.en: Minnesota proposes carrying the freeway on pillars along the Duluth lakefront.
events.zh: 明尼苏达提出以立柱高架方式沿德卢斯湖滨修建高速公路。

events.en: Construction begins on the first Interstate work in Florida, on I-4 between Plant City and Lakeland.
events.zh: 佛罗里达州首项州际公路工程动工，位于 I-4 普兰特城至莱克兰之间。

events.en: The East–West Expressway in Winston-Salem becomes North Carolina's first completed Interstate section, as part of I-40.
events.zh: 温斯顿-塞勒姆东西快速路作为 I-40 的一部分，成为北卡罗来纳州首段建成的州际公路。

events.en: The Oklahoma Highway Commission designates the two turnpikes as I-44 on 14 July — a signage decision only; the roads remain tolled.
events.zh: 7 月 14 日，俄克拉何马州公路委员会将两条收费公路指定为 I-44——仅为标志牌上的决定，道路继续收费。

events.en: The outer circumferential highway is assigned the number I-495.
events.zh: 这条外围环状公路获得 I-495 编号。

events.en: The first section on Long Island proper opens in Nassau County.
events.zh: 长岛本岛上的第一段在拿骚县通车。

events.en: Louisiana begins building a replacement for US 11 across the Pearl River — the first work on the corridor.
events.zh: 路易斯安那开始修建跨越珍珠河、取代 US 11 的道路，这是本走廊上最早的工程。

events.en: I-69 is added to the Interstate System along a shorter route than the modern highway, having been left off the mid-1950s planning maps.
events.zh: I-69 被补入州际公路系统，线路比今日更短；它未出现在 1950 年代中期的规划图上。

events.en: AASHO approves the number I-696 in place of Michigan's proposed I-98.
events.zh: 美国州公路工作者协会批准 I-696 编号，取代密歇根州提议的 I-98。

events.en: The Illini Expressway and the Murray Baker Bridge at Peoria are dedicated on 12 December — the first section of I-74 open anywhere. AASHO approves the Illinois alignment the month before.
events.zh: 12 月 12 日，皮奥里亚的伊利尼快速路与默里·贝克大桥落成通车，是全美最早通车的 I-74 路段。前一个月 AASHO 批准了伊利诺伊线位。

events.en: The turnpike is brought into the two-year-old Interstate System.
events.zh: 这条收费公路被纳入成立两年的州际公路系统。

events.en: I-78 is designated along a line broadly following US 22.
events.zh: I-78 沿大体循 US 22 的走向定名。

events.en: The route is assigned the number I-80N, a northern fork of I-80 following US 30.
events.zh: 本路线获编号 I-80N，作为 I-80 的北支，循 US 30 而行。

events.en: The first section opens in Vermont on 1 November, the state's first controlled-access highway.
events.zh: 11 月 1 日，佛蒙特州首段通车，为该州第一条限制出入公路。

events.en: North Dakota dedicates its first section, between Valley City and Jamestown.
events.zh: 北达科他州瓦利城至詹姆斯敦的首段举行落成仪式。

events.en: The México–Querétaro toll motorway begins operating on 1 October; President Adolfo Ruiz Cortines inaugurates the road at San Juan del Río.
events.zh: 10 月 1 日，墨西哥城—克雷塔罗收费高速开始运营；阿道弗·鲁伊斯·科蒂内斯总统在圣胡安德尔里奥为该路揭幕。

events.en: Ottawa plans a road from Dawson City to Aklavik; the northern terminus is later changed to the new town of Inuvik.
events.zh: 渥太华规划一条自道森市通往阿克拉维克的道路，北端终点后改为新建的伊努维克镇。

events.en: The route is realigned onto the Freeman Diversion at Burlington, begun the day the Burlington Bay Skyway opened, 31 October.
events.zh: 线路改走伯灵顿的弗里曼改线段，工程于 10 月 31 日——伯灵顿湾跨海高架桥通车当日——开工。

events.en: The province chooses the Tainan–Taitung line, then shelves it for lack of money.
events.zh: 省府选定台南至台东路线，随即因经费无着而搁置。

events.en: The Provincial Highway Bureau completes the survey of the cross-island line in February.
events.zh: 2 月，台湾省公路局完成横贯路线踏勘测量。

events.en: The northern terminus moves out of downtown Olympia.
events.zh: 北端终点迁出奥林匹亚市中心。

events.en: Ottawa decides to build a road from Dawson City to the Arctic; survey work begins.
events.zh: 渥太华决定修建自道森市通往北极的道路，勘测工作启动。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute des Laurentides — De la jonction de l'autoroute 40 à Montréal à la sortie 16 à Laval.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute des Laurentides） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 40 à Montréal à la sortie 16 à Laval。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: A second amendment to the Trans-Canada Highway Act, passed in March, adds $100 million to the federal contribution.
events.zh: 3 月通过的《横加公路法》第二次修正案，为联邦出资再增 1 亿加元。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1962, p. 783

events.en: The first I-196 markers go up — on the Grand Rapids–Muskegon freeway, now I-96.
events.zh: 首批 I-196 标志立起，位于今为 I-96 的大急流城－马斯基根高速上。

events.en: Texas applies the I-20 number to its own section, to replace or parallel US 80.
events.zh: 得克萨斯将 I-20 编号用于本州路段，取代或平行于 US 80。

events.en: The Texas Transportation Commission authorises the I-37 designation on 1 October.
events.zh: 10 月 1 日，得州交通委员会核定 I-37 编号。

events.en: The first segment opens between Plant City and Lakeland.
events.zh: 普兰特城至莱克兰的首段通车。

events.en: Construction of the belt around Marion County begins.
events.zh: 环绕马里恩县的环线开工建设。

events.en: The first section of the Bloomington Strip opens between Highway 100 and Highway 5.
events.zh: 布卢明顿带首段在 100 号公路与 5 号公路之间通车。

events.en: The first section of what is now southern I-495 opens as Route 25 in Middleborough.
events.zh: 今日 I-495 南段的首段以 25 号州道形式在米德尔伯勒通车。

events.en: The first sections open, signed both as SR 1 and with their new Interstate numbers.
events.zh: 首批路段通车，同时挂 SR 1 与新的州际公路编号。

events.en: Construction begins in May at the northern end, near Ellensburg.
events.zh: 5 月，工程自北端埃伦斯堡附近动工。

events.en: The elevated Central Artery opens through downtown Boston with six lanes.
events.zh: 六车道的高架中央干道穿过波士顿市中心通车。

events.en: Travellers through Nogales into the interior reach 73,000 a year, nearly double the 1954 figure.
events.zh: 经诺加莱斯进入内地的旅客达到每年 73,000 人，几乎是 1954 年的两倍。

events.en: The planned start is postponed after the August flood; work on the Baitao–Siling logging road begins.
events.zh: 八七水灾后原定开工延后；百韬桥至四棱林道开始辟筑。

events.en: Montana has the route swung west from Forsyth through Helena to Missoula, replacing the Yellowstone branch.
events.zh: 蒙大拿州将本路线自福赛思改向西行，经海伦娜至米苏拉，取代原通往黄石的分支。

events.en: With the Glen Canyon Bridge complete, US 89 is moved onto a new alignment through Page; the old road becomes US 89A.
events.zh: 格伦峡谷大桥建成后，US 89 改走经佩吉的新线，旧路改编为 US 89A。

events.en: Construction of the North Cascades crossing begins on the northerly alignment.
events.zh: 北喀斯喀特越岭段按偏北走向开工。

events.en: Oil is found on the Eagle Plain on 17 August and the first 48 km are begun, as the flagship of Diefenbaker's Roads to Resources.
events.zh: 8 月 17 日鹰原发现石油，最初 48 公里开工，成为迪芬贝克「通往资源之路」的旗舰工程。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute Décarie — De la sortie 66 à la jonction de l'autoroute 40 à Montréal.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute Décarie） — De la sortie 66 à la jonction de l'autoroute 40 à Montréal。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute des Laurentides — De la sortie 16 à Laval à la sortie 43 à Saint-Jérôme.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute des Laurentides） — De la sortie 16 à Laval à la sortie 43 à Saint-Jérôme。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 40, Autoroute Métropolitaine — De la jonction de l'autoroute 15 à la sortie 76 à Montréal.
events.zh: 通车：40 号高速公路（Autoroute Métropolitaine） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 15 à la sortie 76 à Montréal。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: The Central Cross-Island Highway opens on 9 May, half a year early, the first road across the island. It cost about NT$494.6 million, NT$389.9 million of it American aid.
events.zh: 5 月 9 日，中部横贯公路提前半年通车，是台湾第一条串联东西部的公路。工程费约新台币 4 亿 9,456 万元，其中美援 3 亿 8,994 万元。
events.source: zh.wikipedia, 中部橫貫公路

events.en: A third amendment in June raises federal funds under the Trans-Canada Highway Act to $400 million and extends the construction period by three years. The agreements now call for a paved highway across Canada by 31 May 1964.
events.zh: 6 月的第三次修正案将《横加公路法》项下的联邦资金提高到 4 亿加元，并将施工期延长三年。各项协议改为要求在 1964 年 5 月 31 日前建成横贯全国的铺装公路。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1962, p. 783

events.en: The rebuilt Suzhou–Shanghai road reopens as Cao'an Road.
events.zh: 苏沪公路改建通车，更名曹安路。

events.en: Plans for the Papago Freeway through Phoenix are formalised.
events.zh: 穿越凤凰城的帕帕戈高速公路规划正式确立。

events.en: The Verde leg from Cordes Junction to Flagstaff, State Route 79, is finished; ADOT accounts date it to 1960 and to September 1961.
events.zh: 从科德斯枢纽至弗拉格斯塔夫的韦尔德段（SR 79）建成；亚利桑那州交通部的记述分别给出 1960 年与 1961 年 9 月两个时间。

events.en: Construction starts at the summit of Raton Pass; Colorado Springs finishes its freeway in July.
events.zh: 拉顿山口顶部动工；科罗拉多斯普林斯的高速公路于 7 月建成。

events.en: The Washington National Pike is complete between Bethesda and Frederick.
events.zh: 华盛顿国家大道在贝塞斯达与弗雷德里克之间建成。

events.en: The Fort Pitt Tunnel opens toll-free, linking Monroeville to the airport.
events.zh: 皮特堡隧道免费通车，把门罗维尔与机场连起来。

events.en: The first Louisiana sections open, bypassing Ponchatoula and Hammond.
events.zh: 路易斯安那首批路段通车，绕过庞查图拉与哈蒙德。

events.en: The first freeway section of the loop opens, on the North Loop.
events.zh: 环线的第一段高速在北环通车。

events.en: The Pennsylvania expressway receives the I-83 designation.
events.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州这条快速路获得 I-83 编号。

events.en: The first section opens in Vermont between Montpelier and Middlesex in November.
events.zh: 11 月，佛蒙特州蒙彼利埃至米德尔塞克斯的首段通车。

events.en: The Hawaii Omnibus Act brings Hawaii into the federal-aid Interstate programme.
events.zh: 《夏威夷综合法案》将夏威夷纳入联邦资助的州际公路计划。

events.en: The Hawaii Omnibus Act brings Hawaii into the federal-aid Interstate programme and authorises H-1, H-2 and H-3 on national-defence grounds.
events.zh: 《夏威夷综合法案》将夏威夷纳入联邦资助的州际公路计划，并以国防理由授权修建 H-1、H-2 与 H-3。

events.en: On 18 October the World Bank lends US$25 million for thirteen Mexican roads, including Acapulco–Pinotepa Nacional, Pinotepa–Puerto Escondido, Compostela–Puerto Vallarta and Arriaga–Tapachula.
events.zh: 10 月 18 日，世界银行向墨西哥提供 2,500 万美元贷款修建十三条道路，其中包括阿卡普尔科—皮诺特帕纳西奥纳尔、皮诺特帕—埃斯孔迪多港、孔波斯特拉—巴亚尔塔港和阿里亚加—塔帕丘拉。

events.en: The 165-mile Lake Superior gap between Wawa and Sault Ste. Marie opens in September, making it possible for the first time to drive across Canada without entering the United States.
events.zh: 9 月，瓦瓦至苏圣玛丽之间 165 英里的苏必利尔湖缺口通车，人们首次得以不经美国横穿加拿大。

events.en: Jean Lesage becomes premier on 5 July; Quebec signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 27 October, ten and a half years after the other provinces.
events.zh: 7 月 5 日让·勒萨日出任省长；10 月 27 日，魁北克签署横加公路协议，比其他省份晚了十年半。

events.en: The road opens on 9 May, half a year ahead of schedule.
events.zh: 5 月 9 日通车，比预定提早半年。

events.en: A bridge replaces the Alligator River ferry, completing the road link to the Outer Banks.
events.zh: 鳄鱼河渡轮改建为桥梁，通往外滩群岛的陆路由此贯通。

events.en: AASHO approves a 128-mile extension from Ehrenberg to the Mexican border at San Luis, replacing Arizona's SR 95.
events.zh: AASHO 批准自埃伦伯格至圣路易斯墨西哥边境的 128 英里延伸段，取代亚利桑那 95 号州道。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 40, Autoroute Métropolitaine — Échangeur Décarie.
events.zh: 通车：40 号高速公路（Autoroute Métropolitaine） — Échangeur Décarie。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Lung Cheung Road opens on 24 June.
events.zh: 6 月 24 日，龙翔道通车。

events.en: The full-length toll rises from 50 to 60 cents.
events.zh: 全程通行费由 50 美分升至 60 美分。

events.en: Ground is broken in Corpus Christi on 10 October.
events.zh: 10 月 10 日在科珀斯克里斯蒂破土动工。

events.en: The first section opens to traffic.
events.zh: 首段通车。

events.en: The original Woodrow Wilson Bridge opens across the Potomac.
events.zh: 最初的伍德罗·威尔逊大桥跨波托马克河通车。

events.en: The first Illinois section, thirty miles from Dongola north to Marion, is dedicated on 26 September.
events.zh: 9 月 26 日，伊利诺伊首段落成：自东哥拉北上至马里恩，全长三十英里。

events.en: The first section of the Jones Falls Expressway opens in Baltimore in December.
events.zh: 12 月，琼斯瀑布快速路首段在巴尔的摩通车。

events.en: British Columbia assumes the first 133 km, from Dawson Creek to north of Fort St John.
events.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚接管起始 133 公里，自道森克里克至圣约翰堡以北。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 640, Autoroute 640 — Du boul. des Promenades à Deux-Montagnes à l'autoroute 15 à Boisbriand (sorties 8 à 20).
events.zh: 通车：640 号高速公路（Autoroute 640） — Du boul. des Promenades à Deux-Montagnes à l'autoroute 15 à Boisbriand (sorties 8 à 20)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: The Trans-Canada Highway is officially opened on 3 September, once the last major gap in the mountains has closed. It can be driven end to end for the first time, but construction is still going on in a number of sections: this is an opening, not a completion.
events.zh: 山区最后一处主要缺口闭合后，横加公路于 9 月 3 日正式通车，首次可以全程贯通驾驶。但多个路段仍在施工：这是通车，而非完工。
events.source: Canada Year Book 1963-64, p. 772

events.en: Premier W.A.C. Bennett opens the Rogers Pass road for British Columbia on 30 July; Prime Minister Diefenbaker declares the Trans-Canada Highway open at the pass on 3 September.
events.zh: 7 月 30 日，省长 W.A.C. 贝内特代表不列颠哥伦比亚为罗杰斯山口公路剪彩；9 月 3 日，总理迪芬贝克在该山口宣布横加公路通车。

events.en: The route is complete in southern Nevada from the California line to Sloan.
events.zh: 内华达州南部自加州州界至斯隆段建成。

events.en: The first three miles open, a stub south from I-10 to Valencia Road in Tucson.
events.zh: 首段三英里通车：自图森 I-10 南至瓦伦西亚路的短线。

events.en: A twin span opens beside the 1935 South Grand Island Bridge.
events.zh: 1935 年建成的南大岛桥旁增建的孪生桥通车。

events.en: Construction of the Monteagle Mountain crossing begins.
events.zh: 蒙蒂格尔山越岭段动工。

events.en: Three states announce an 80-mile, $153 million loop around Cincinnati.
events.zh: 三州宣布环绕辛辛那提的 80 英里、1.53 亿美元环线计划。

events.en: A northbound section over the Big Sioux River collapses in an April flood.
events.zh: 4 月洪水中，一段跨大苏河的北行路面垮塌。

events.en: The I-40 interchange at North Little Rock opens, fixing the route's northern end; Texas approves 240 miles of I-30.
events.zh: 北小石城 I-40 立交通车，确定本路线北端；得克萨斯批准本州 240 英里的 I-30。

events.en: The route is through from Tampa to Orlando.
events.zh: 坦帕至奥兰多全线贯通。

events.en: The Sepulveda Pass crossing opens, linking the San Fernando Valley to the Westside.
events.zh: 塞普尔韦达山口段通车，连接圣费尔南多谷与西城。

events.en: The first Benicia–Martinez Bridge opens, carrying two-way traffic over the Carquinez Strait.
events.zh: 第一座贝尼西亚—马丁内斯大桥通车，双向交通跨越卡奎内斯海峡。

events.en: The main arc of the Baltimore Beltway is completed from MD 2 round to US 40.
events.zh: 巴尔的摩环线主弧段建成，自 MD 2 绕至 US 40。

events.en: The I-71 designation is established in Ohio; the redundant SR 1 shields come down in 1966.
events.zh: I-71 编号在俄亥俄确立；多余的 SR 1 标志于 1966 年撤下。

events.en: The JFX is completed to the Baltimore Beltway on 2 November.
events.zh: 11 月 2 日，JFX 建成接通巴尔的摩环城路。

events.en: The route opens across the state on 12 December; US 16 is decommissioned in Michigan.
events.zh: 12 月 12 日，本路线在全州范围通车；US 16 在密歇根州被撤销。

events.en: The highway is declared open at Rogers Pass while roughly 600 km of Newfoundland's section is still gravel.
events.zh: 横加公路在罗杰斯山口宣布通车，而纽芬兰境内尚有约 600 公里为碎石路面。

events.en: The Bayshore Freeway between San Jose and San Francisco is completed after fifteen years of staged openings.
events.zh: 圣何塞至旧金山的贝肖尔高速公路在分段通车十五年后全线建成。

events.en: The Lolo Pass link opens and US 12 is extended to Lewiston, Idaho; in Michigan the number moves off I-94 onto the old Chicago Road.
events.zh: 洛洛山口路段通车，US 12 延伸至爱达荷州刘易斯敦；在密歇根州，该编号从 I-94 移至旧芝加哥路。

events.en: Construction stops after 115 km of roadbed, the Eagle Plains discovery having proved commercially worthless.
events.zh: 在修成 115 公里路基后停工，鹰原的发现被证明毫无商业价值。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 10, Autoroute des Cantons-de-l'Est — De la jonction de l'autoroute 15 à Montréal (Île-des-Sœurs) à la jonction de l'autoroute 15 et 20 à Brossard..
events.zh: 通车：10 号高速公路（Autoroute des Cantons-de-l'Est） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 15 à Montréal (Île-des-Sœurs) à la jonction de l'autoroute 15 et 20 à Brossard.。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 40, Autoroute Félix-Leclerc — De la jonction de l'autoroute 540 (Duplessis) à la jonction des autoroutes 73 et 440 à Québec.
events.zh: 通车：40 号高速公路（Autoroute Félix-Leclerc） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 540 (Duplessis) à la jonction des autoroutes 73 et 440 à Québec。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 440, Autoroute Charest — De la jonction des autoroutes 40 et 73 à l'intersection de l'avenue Saint-Sacrement à Québec. (2e chaussée ouverte en 1967).
events.zh: 通车：440 号高速公路（Autoroute Charest） — De la jonction des autoroutes 40 et 73 à l'intersection de l'avenue Saint-Sacrement à Québec. (2e chaussée ouverte en 1967)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Construction begins on the first 16 miles, in Laurens and Treutlen counties.
events.zh: 首段 16 英里工程在劳伦斯县与特鲁特伦县动工。

events.en: The first piece of the belt opens near the airport.
events.zh: 环线首段在机场附近通车。

events.en: The first section of freeway opens in Corpus Christi in May.
events.zh: 5 月，科珀斯克里斯蒂首段高速通车。

events.en: With the eastern half still unbuilt, the press is already calling the expressway the world's longest parking lot.
events.zh: 东半段尚未修建，媒体已称这条快速路为「世界上最长的停车场」。

events.en: The first Chicago portion opens on 6 November, 1.1 miles west from the Dan Ryan and Calumet expressway junction to Halsted Street.
events.zh: 11 月 6 日，芝加哥首段通车：自丹·瑞安与卡卢梅特快速路交汇处西行 1.1 英里至霍尔斯特德街。

events.en: Mississippi opens its first sections, from the Louisiana line toward Picayune and from Hattiesburg to Laurel.
events.zh: 密西西比开放首批路段：自路易斯安那州界至皮卡尤恩，以及哈蒂斯堡至劳雷尔。

events.en: The western third opens between I-96 and US 24.
events.zh: 西三分之一在 I-96 与 US 24 之间通车。

events.en: The Department of Highways begins rebuilding the Toronto Bypass into a collector-express system — 24 main contracts and 20 interchanges over nine years.
events.zh: 公路厅着手把多伦多绕城线改建为快速—集散系统：二十四份主体合同、二十座立交，历时九年。

events.en: Work on the highway begins on 1 May.
events.zh: 5 月 1 日北横公路开工。

events.en: AASHO approves truncating the route from Los Angeles to Blythe, California, on 26 August.
events.zh: 8 月 26 日，AASHO 批准将本路线自洛杉矶截短至加利福尼亚州布莱斯。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute des Laurentides — De la sortie 43 à Saint-Jérôme à la sortie 60 à Saint-Sauveur.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute des Laurentides） — De la sortie 43 à Saint-Jérôme à la sortie 60 à Saint-Sauveur。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 40, Autoroute Félix-Leclerc — De la sortie 50 à Kirkland à la jonction de l’autoroute 15 à Montréal.
events.zh: 通车：40 号高速公路（Autoroute Félix-Leclerc） — De la sortie 50 à Kirkland à la jonction de l’autoroute 15 à Montréal。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 73, Autoroute Henri-IV — Du boul. Champlain à l'autoroute 440 à Québec (sorties 132 à 139).
events.zh: 通车：73 号高速公路（Autoroute Henri-IV） — Du boul. Champlain à l'autoroute 440 à Québec (sorties 132 à 139)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 73, Autoroute Laurentienne — De l'intersection de l'autoroute 40 à Québec à l'avenue de la Rivière-Jaune (sortie 158).
events.zh: 通车：73 号高速公路（Autoroute Laurentienne） — De l'intersection de l'autoroute 40 à Québec à l'avenue de la Rivière-Jaune (sortie 158)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: The MacArthur Highway opens on 2 May between Keelung and Taipei, Taiwan's first road for motor vehicles only. Most of it later becomes the north end of Freeway 1.
events.zh: 5 月 2 日，基隆至台北的麦帅公路通车，是台湾第一条汽车专用公路，后来大部分并入国道 1 号北段。
events.source: zh.wikipedia, 中山高速公路 (历史)

events.en: The state route number 99 is assigned as the state renumbering takes effect.
events.zh: 随着州道重新编号生效，99 号州道编号确立。

events.en: A dedication ceremony for a section of I-17 in Phoenix is held on 10 November.
events.zh: 11 月 10 日，凤凰城 I-17 一段举行通车典礼。

events.en: At a public meeting in Nogales, the town argues for the freeway to stop short of the border; a waiver from Interstate requirements follows.
events.zh: 诺加莱斯的公众会议上，镇方主张高速公路不应直抵边境；随后获得州际公路标准的豁免。

events.en: The route is complete.
events.zh: 全线建成。

events.en: The numbers are swapped west of Grand Rapids and the Grand Rapids section opens in December.
events.zh: 大急流城以西两个编号互换，大急流城段于 12 月通车。

events.en: The Bureau of Public Roads authorises the extension north-west to Pulleys Mill, Illinois.
events.zh: 公共道路局批准向西北延伸至伊利诺伊州普利斯米尔。

events.en: The Colorado–Wyoming link opens on 11 October.
events.zh: 科罗拉多—怀俄明衔接段于 10 月 11 日通车。

events.en: The I-271 designation comes into use.
events.zh: I-271 编号启用。

events.en: The Brooklyn–Queens Expressway is completed after 27 years of construction.
events.zh: 历经 27 年施工，布鲁克林—皇后区快速路全线建成。

events.en: The freeway through Fort Worth is completed.
events.zh: 穿过沃思堡的高速公路建成。

events.en: Virginia completes its 22 miles in April and Maryland its 41 miles in August, closing the ring.
events.zh: 弗吉尼亚州 4 月建成本州 22 英里，马里兰州 8 月建成 41 英里，环线合拢。

events.en: Chicago's Southwest Expressway opens on 1 September; a year later it is renamed for Adlai E. Stevenson II.
events.zh: 9 月 1 日，芝加哥西南快速路通车；一年后更名为阿德莱·史蒂文森二世快速路。

events.en: California adopts a route for the final five miles north through South Pasadena and Pasadena.
events.zh: 加州通过最后五英里北段线位，穿越南帕萨迪纳与帕萨迪纳。

events.en: The Laurel Hill bypass opens on 30 October, retiring the first of the original seven tunnels.
events.zh: 10 月 30 日劳雷尔山绕行线通车，最初七座隧道中的第一座退役。

events.en: California's state highway renumbering applies the I-8 designation in place of US 80.
events.zh: 加州公路重编号以 I-8 取代 US 80 的编号。

events.en: The ten-mile section over Donner Summit opens, replacing US 40 as the trans-Sierra route.
events.zh: 翻越唐纳顶的十英里路段通车，取代 US 40 成为跨内华达山脉的路线。

events.en: South Carolina opens its entire section, the first Interstate completed in that state.
events.zh: 南卡罗来纳州全州路段通车，为该州第一条建成的州际公路。

events.en: The Ozark National Scenic Riverways is created, taking in over 134 miles of the upper Current River.
events.zh: 欧扎克国家风景河区设立，纳入卡伦特河上游 134 英里以上河段。

events.en: The route becomes driveable from Windsor to the Quebec border.
events.zh: 自温莎至魁北克省界全程可通行。

events.en: The MacArthur Highway opens on 2 May from Keelung harbour to Taipei — Taiwan's first motorway, and the freeway's first piece.
events.zh: 5 月 2 日，麦帅公路自基隆港至台北通车——台湾第一条汽车专用公路，也是日后中山高速公路的第一段。

events.en: California's renumbering takes effect: I-5 replaces US 101 from Los Angeles to the Mexican border and the route is cut back to the East Los Angeles Interchange.
events.zh: 加利福尼亚的重新编号生效：I-5 取代洛杉矶至墨西哥边境的 US 101，本路线被收缩至东洛杉矶枢纽。

events.en: With US 6 truncated in California, US 20 becomes the longest road in the United States.
events.zh: US 6 在加州被截短后，US 20 成为全美最长的公路。

events.en: California's renumbering cuts US 50 back from the Bay Area to Sacramento.
events.zh: 加州重新编号，把 US 50 自湾区收回至萨克拉门托。

events.en: California's renumbering takes effect on 1 July and the western terminus moves to Bishop; the route loses its Pacific end.
events.zh: 7 月 1 日加州重新编号生效，西端点移至比肖普，本路线失去太平洋端点。

events.en: California's renumbering removes US 60 from the state; the route is cut back to Brenda, Arizona.
events.zh: 加州重新编号将 US 60 从州内撤除，本路线被收回至亚利桑那州布伦达。

events.en: The number SR 20 is created in the state renumbering, then running only from the Mount Vernon area to Okanogan.
events.zh: 州道重新编号中设立 SR 20 编号，当时仅自弗农山一带通至奥卡诺根。

events.en: Operations of the 835 km federal section pass to the department that is today Public Services and Procurement Canada.
events.zh: 联邦管辖的 835 公里路段移交给今日的加拿大公共服务和采购部运营。

events.en: The road is named the Dempster Highway, after Inspector William Dempster of the Mounted Police. Some accounts date the naming to September 1963.
events.zh: 该路以皇家骑警警官威廉·邓普斯特命名。另有记载称命名于 1963 年 9 月。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 5, Autoroute de la Gatineau — De la frontière ontarienne à la sortie 5 à Gatineau.
events.zh: 通车：5 号高速公路（Autoroute de la Gatineau） — De la frontière ontarienne à la sortie 5 à Gatineau。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 10, Autoroute des Cantons-de-l'Est — De la jonction de l'autoroute 15 et 20 à Brossard à la jonction de l'autoroute 55 à Magog.
events.zh: 通车：10 号高速公路（Autoroute des Cantons-de-l'Est） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 15 et 20 à Brossard à la jonction de l'autoroute 55 à Magog。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute des Laurentides — De la sortie 60 à Saint-Sauveur-des-Monts à la sortie 69 à Estérel.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute des Laurentides） — De la sortie 60 à Saint-Sauveur-des-Monts à la sortie 69 à Estérel。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 20, Autoroute René-Lévesque — De la jonction des autoroutes 10 et 15 à Brossard à la jonction de l'autoroute 25 à Longueuil.
events.zh: 通车：20 号高速公路（Autoroute René-Lévesque） — De la jonction des autoroutes 10 et 15 à Brossard à la jonction de l'autoroute 25 à Longueuil。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 20, Autoroute Jean-Lesage — De la sortie 105 à Saint-Mathieu-de-Beloeil à la sortie 312 à Lévis.
events.zh: 通车：20 号高速公路（Autoroute Jean-Lesage） — De la sortie 105 à Saint-Mathieu-de-Beloeil à la sortie 312 à Lévis。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 55, Autoroute de l'Énergie — De la route 351 à la 6e Avenue à Shawinigan (sorties 217 à 223)..
events.zh: 通车：55 号高速公路（Autoroute de l'Énergie） — De la route 351 à la 6e Avenue à Shawinigan (sorties 217 à 223).。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: South Carolina's first completed piece, the bridge over the Savannah River, opens.
events.zh: 南卡罗来纳最先完工的路段——跨萨凡纳河大桥——通车。

events.en: The Ridge Cut through Chattanooga is dedicated on 1 December.
events.zh: 12 月 1 日，穿过查塔努加的「山脊切口」举行通车典礼。

events.en: Organised opposition begins in northern New Jersey and stops the project for a generation.
events.zh: 新泽西州北部出现有组织的反对，工程停摆一代人之久。

events.en: I-4 is substantially complete from Tampa to Daytona Beach.
events.zh: I-4 自坦帕至代托纳比奇基本建成。

events.en: Two disconnected segments open, one in Kansas and one in Missouri.
events.zh: 两段互不相连的路通车，分别位于堪萨斯州与密苏里州。

events.en: The Appalachian Regional Development Act designates the corridor as Appalachian Development Highway System Corridor E.
events.zh: 《阿巴拉契亚区域开发法》将该走廊列为阿巴拉契亚开发公路系统 E 号走廊。

events.en: The section from Swanton to Highgate opens, carrying the route to the Canadian border.
events.zh: 斯旺顿至海盖特路段通车，本路线抵达加拿大边境。

events.en: The Lunalilo Freeway is designated H-1 and the route is extended west toward Barbers Point.
events.zh: 卢纳利洛高速被定名为 H-1，路线向西延伸至巴伯斯角方向。

events.en: Paving is completed on 27 November, on the strength of Ottawa's agreement to pay ninety per cent.
events.zh: 11 月 27 日铺装完工，仰赖渥太华同意承担九成费用。

events.en: The road is named the Macdonald–Cartier Freeway.
events.zh: 该路获名「麦克唐纳—卡蒂埃高速公路」。

events.en: Numbered Highway 1, 501.098 km from the Executive Yuan to Eluanbi.
events.zh: 编为台 1 线，自行政院至鹅銮鼻，长 501.098 公里。

events.en: The eastern industrial roads programme begins in March.
events.zh: 3 月，东部产业道路新辟工程开工。

events.en: The route is extended from Austin to Brady over cancelled Ranch to Market Roads 93 and 734.
events.zh: 路线沿被撤销的 93 号与 734 号农市道路自奥斯汀延伸至布雷迪。

events.en: Arizona extends US 93 from Kingman to US 89 near Wickenburg; a proposed extension to Nogales is refused.
events.zh: 亚利桑那把 US 93 自金曼延伸至威肯堡附近的 US 89；拟延伸至诺加莱斯的方案被否决。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 40, Autoroute Métropolitaine — De la sortie 76 à la sortie 78 à Montréal.
events.zh: 通车：40 号高速公路（Autoroute Métropolitaine） — De la sortie 76 à la sortie 78 à Montréal。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 55, Autoroute Joseph-Armand-Bombardier — De l'intersection de la route 112 à la jonction de l'autoroute 10 à Magog (sorties 33 à 34).
events.zh: 通车：55 号高速公路（Autoroute Joseph-Armand-Bombardier） — De l'intersection de la route 112 à la jonction de l'autoroute 10 à Magog (sorties 33 à 34)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: The Beeline designation is extended over the former SR 65 between Winslow and Strawberry.
events.zh: 蜂线公路名号扩展至温斯洛与斯特罗伯里之间的原 SR 65。

events.en: Princess Margaret Road opens in Kowloon.
events.zh: 九龙公主道通车。

events.en: Ching Cheung Road opens in November.
events.zh: 11 月，呈祥道通车。

events.en: Arizona halts all work in the Virgin River Gorge after federal highway funds are cut.
events.zh: 联邦公路资金削减后，亚利桑那全面停止维尔京河峡谷段施工。

events.en: The first segment opens to traffic on 11 October.
events.zh: 首段于 10 月 11 日通车。

events.en: The short extension east from the Dan Ryan Expressway to Lake Shore Drive completes I-55 in Chicago.
events.zh: 自丹·瑞安快速路向东至湖滨大道的短延伸段建成，I-55 在芝加哥段全部完工。

events.en: Premier Smallwood and Prime Minister Pearson meet at Pearson's Peak near Grand Falls on 12 July to open the highway in Newfoundland.
events.zh: 7 月 12 日，省长斯莫尔伍德与总理皮尔逊在大瀑布城附近的皮尔逊峰会合，为纽芬兰段公路剪彩。

events.en: The Platte-Winner Bridge opens across Lake Francis Case, ten years after Fort Randall Dam.
events.zh: 普拉特—温纳大桥跨越弗朗西斯·凯斯湖通车，距兰德尔堡大坝建成十年。

events.en: Chiang Kai-shek tells the provincial governor in May that the road should be built.
events.zh: 5 月，蒋中正指示省主席黄杰南横仍应修建。

events.en: The road opens on 28 May at Dapu, Sanxia.
events.zh: 5 月 28 日在三峡大埔举行通车典礼。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute 15 — De la frontière des États-Unis à Saint-Bernard-de-Lacolle à la jonction de l'autoroute 930 et de la route 132 à Candiac.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute 15） — De la frontière des États-Unis à Saint-Bernard-de-Lacolle à la jonction de l'autoroute 930 et de la route 132 à Candiac。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 15, Autoroute René-Lévesque — De la jonction de l'autoroute 930 et de la route 132 à Candiac à la jonction des autoroutes 10 et 20 à Brossard.
events.zh: 通车：15 号高速公路（Autoroute René-Lévesque） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 930 et de la route 132 à Candiac à la jonction des autoroutes 10 et 20 à Brossard。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 20, Autoroute du Souvenir — De la frontière de l'Ontario à Rivière-Beaudette à l'autoroute 520 à Montréal (sortie 56).
events.zh: 通车：20 号高速公路（Autoroute du Souvenir） — De la frontière de l'Ontario à Rivière-Beaudette à l'autoroute 520 à Montréal (sortie 56)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 20, Autoroute Jean-Lesage — De la jonction de l'autoroute 25 à la sortie 105 à Saint-Mathieu-de-Beloeil.
events.zh: 通车：20 号高速公路（Autoroute Jean-Lesage） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 25 à la sortie 105 à Saint-Mathieu-de-Beloeil。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 25, Autoroute Transcanadienne — De la jonction de l'autoroute 20 à Boucherville à la sortie 4 à Montréal (Inauguration du pont-tunnel Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine en 1967).
events.zh: 通车：25 号高速公路（Autoroute Transcanadienne） — De la jonction de l'autoroute 20 à Boucherville à la sortie 4 à Montréal (Inauguration du pont-tunnel Louis-Hippolyte-La Fontaine en 1967)。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 31, Autoroute Antonio-Barrette — De la jonction de la route 131 à Lavaltrie à la jonction du carrefour giratoire du boulevard Dollard à Joliette.
events.zh: 通车：31 号高速公路（Autoroute Antonio-Barrette） — De la jonction de la route 131 à Lavaltrie à la jonction du carrefour giratoire du boulevard Dollard à Joliette。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 35, Autoroute de la Vallée-des-Forts — De la jonction de la route 104 (sortie 39) à Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu à la jonction de l'autoroute 10 (sortie 55) à Chambly.
events.zh: 通车：35 号高速公路（Autoroute de la Vallée-des-Forts） — De la jonction de la route 104 (sortie 39) à Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu à la jonction de l'autoroute 10 (sortie 55) à Chambly。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 40, Autoroute Félix-Leclerc — De la frontière de l'Ontario à Pointe-Fortune à la sortie 50 à Kirkland.
events.zh: 通车：40 号高速公路（Autoroute Félix-Leclerc） — De la frontière de l'Ontario à Pointe-Fortune à la sortie 50 à Kirkland。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 520, Autoroute de la Côte-de-Liesse — De l'autoroute 20 à l'autoroute 40 à Montréal.
events.zh: 通车：520 号高速公路（Autoroute de la Côte-de-Liesse） — De l'autoroute 20 à l'autoroute 40 à Montréal。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 540, Autoroute Duplessis — De la jonction de l'autoroute Henri-IV (73) au boul. Wilfrid-Hamel (138) à Québec..
events.zh: 通车：540 号高速公路（Autoroute Duplessis） — De la jonction de l'autoroute Henri-IV (73) au boul. Wilfrid-Hamel (138) à Québec.。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: Lion Rock Tunnel opens on 14 November, Hong Kong's first road tunnel, as a single tube with traffic both ways.
events.zh: 11 月 14 日，狮子山隧道通车，为香港第一条行车隧道，单管双程行车。

events.en: The first sections open to traffic in January.
events.zh: 首批路段于 1 月通车。

events.en: The easternmost 28 miles open in the Savannah area on 24 November.
events.zh: 萨凡纳一带最东端 28 英里于 11 月 24 日通车。
