events.en: Work on the Nan 133 viaduct and the Gangkou interchange begins on 18 October.
events.zh: 10 月 18 日，南 133 路口立体化高架桥与港口交流道工程开工。

events.en: The Olancha–Cartago expressway is completed, the last stretch of US 395 to be four-laned in most of Inyo County.
events.zh: 奥兰查—卡塔戈快速路完工，是因约县大部分范围内 US 395 最后改为四车道的一段。

events.en: PennDOT designates 211 miles across four northern Pennsylvania counties as a state Scenic Byway.
events.zh: 宾州交通部将宾夕法尼亚州北部四县境内的 211 英里划定为州级景观道。

events.en: The last six miles of that corridor open, completing the four-lane route between Lewiston and Moscow.
events.zh: 该走廊最后六英里通车，刘易斯顿至莫斯科的四车道路线由此贯通。

events.en: Opened to traffic: Autoroute 35, Autoroute de la Vallée-des-Forts — De la jonction de la route 133 (sortie 5) à Saint-Armand à la jonction de la route 133 (sortie 15) à Saint-Sébastien.
events.zh: 通车：35 号高速公路（Autoroute de la Vallée-des-Forts） — De la jonction de la route 133 (sortie 5) à Saint-Armand à la jonction de la route 133 (sortie 15) à Saint-Sébastien。
events.source: Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec — Répertoire des autoroutes du Québec

events.en: On 12 January the Executive Yuan swaps the alignments of PH 9 and PH 9B, and the Fengtian–Malan stretch becomes part of the new 9B.
events.zh: 1 月 12 日，行政院公告台 9 线主线与台 9 乙线互换并调整路线，丰田至马兰段改编入新台 9 乙线。
events.source: zh.wikipedia, 南迴公路 (路线)

events.en: The system stands at 46,876 miles, including roughly 2,900 miles of turnpikes that were folded in rather than built new.
events.zh: 系统总里程为 46,876 英里，其中约 2,900 英里是并入的既有收费公路，而非新建路段。
events.source: FHWA Interstate Frequently Asked Questions; FHWA Route Log and Finder List, January 2026

events.en: DOT&PF publishes the draft environmental assessment for a four-lane divided rebuild between mileposts 98.5 and 118.
events.zh: 州交通与公共设施部公布 98.5 至 118 英里改建为四车道分隔公路的环境评估草案。

events.en: Regent's Slide is repaired and the Big Sur coast is continuous again for the first time in almost three years.
events.zh: 摄政滑坡修复完成，大苏尔海岸近三年来首次恢复贯通。

events.en: The Buckhorn Summit Slide takes out a pullout and part of the eastbound shoulder, requiring emergency repair.
events.zh: 巴克霍恩岭滑坡冲毁一处路边停车带及部分东行路肩，需应急修复。

events.en: Caltrans rehabilitates the three Wheeler Gorge tunnels under a series of 55-hour weekend full closures.
events.zh: 加州交通局以一系列 55 小时周末全封闭方式整修惠勒峡谷的三座隧道。

events.en: Strengthening works on the Jiangyin bridge reduce it to one lane towards Shanghai from 10 October.
events.zh: 10 月 10 日起，江阴长江大桥加固施工，往上海方向仅留一条车道。

events.en: Guangxi orders work on the Dafengjiang–Gaode section stopped on 25 May to protect spoon-billed sandpiper habitat.
events.zh: 5 月 25 日，广西要求大风江至高德段暂停建设，以保护勺嘴鹬栖息地。

events.en: An ammonium-nitrate lorry explodes after a collision in East Ujimqin on 5 July, killing two; in August the Ministry of Transport says G331 will be completed through by 2030.
events.zh: 7 月 5 日，东乌珠穆沁旗一辆硝酸铵运输车碰撞后爆炸，2 人死亡；8 月，交通运输部表示“十五五”期间 G331 将全面贯通。

events.en: Hubei's northern section reopens at eight lanes on 6 February.
events.zh: 2 月 6 日，湖北北段八车道改扩建工程建成通车。

events.en: Xinhua–Xinning opens on 26 January; Zhangjiajie–Guanzhuang is the last section left.
events.zh: 1 月 26 日，新化至新宁段通车；张家界至官庄段成为最后未通的一段。

events.en: The Liyuan–Dongxiang section in Jiangxi opens to eight-lane traffic on 31 January.
events.zh: 1 月 31 日，江西梨园至东乡段开放八车道通行。

events.en: Ground is broken on the I-26 Connector in April, more than thirty years after planning began.
events.zh: I-26 连接线于 4 月破土，距规划启动已逾三十年。

events.en: New York City commits to rehabilitating the triple cantilever, with construction planned from 2030.
events.zh: 纽约市确定对三层悬臂段实施大修，计划 2030 年开工。

events.en: Approach work for the Ohio River crossing at Evansville is reported 85 per cent complete in August and due to finish within the year; the new roads and bridges will not open to traffic until the river bridge does.
events.zh: 8 月，据报俄亥俄河跨越工程埃文斯维尔一侧的接线工程已完成 85%，预计年内完工；这些新建道路与桥梁要等跨河大桥通车后才会对外开放。

events.en: Pennsylvania designates 62 miles of US 15 between Williamsport and the New York line as I-99; a gap remains between Bellefonte and Williamsport.
events.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州将威廉斯波特至纽约州界之间 62 英里 US 15 定名为 I-99；贝尔方特与威廉斯波特之间仍有缺口。

events.en: Resurfacing of the Estación Don–Nogales corridor, including Guaymas–Hermosillo, is announced in January.
events.zh: 1 月，埃斯塔西翁东—诺加莱斯走廊（含瓜伊马斯—埃莫西约段）重铺工程宣布实施。

events.en: Resurfacing of 33 km between Villa Ahumada and Ciudad Juárez begins in June.
events.zh: 6 月，比亚阿乌马达至华雷斯城之间 33 公里路面翻修开工。

events.en: The ten-to-twelve-lane widening of Tepalcapa–Tepotzotlán is announced on 4 March; work on Tepotzotlán–Jorobas is scheduled to start on 17 August.
events.zh: 3 月 4 日，宣布特帕尔卡帕—特波索特兰段由十车道拓宽为十二车道；特波索特兰—霍罗巴斯段工程定于 8 月 17 日开工。

events.en: Repainting of the Cómoca bridge between Ciudad Valles and Tamazunchale begins on 28 July.
events.zh: 7 月 28 日，巴耶斯城与塔马送查莱之间的科莫卡桥涂装工程开工。

events.en: SICT reports 27 km widened in 2025 and plans 37 km more in Oaxaca; in July it begins conservation work at the Michoacán–Colima border.
events.zh: SICT 报告 2025 年已拓宽 27 公里，计划在瓦哈卡再拓宽 37 公里；7 月，米却肯与科利马交界处的养护工程开工。

events.en: MnDOT begins replacing three flood-damaged culverts, with detours of up to 44 miles.
events.zh: 明尼苏达交通部开始更换三处洪水损毁的涵洞，绕行最长达 44 英里。

events.en: The Gordie Howe International Bridge opens on 27 July, connecting Highway 401 directly to Interstate 75; nearly 8,000 vehicles cross on the first day.
events.zh: 7 月 27 日，戈迪·豪国际大桥通车，401 号公路与 75 号州际公路直接连通，首日通行车辆近 8,000 辆。

events.en: The transport minister tells the National Assembly that some sections will be crossed by ferry, and that a road for the whole 400 km would cost several billion dollars.
events.zh: 交通部长在省议会表示，部分路段将以渡轮通过；若要修通全部 400 公里公路，将耗资数十亿加元。

events.en: The Longtan section moves to the northern bypass in January.
events.zh: 1 月，龙潭市区段改行北侧外环道。

events.en: A study of extending the road to Kaohsiung is approved on 10 April; the Danjiang Bridge opens on 12 May.
events.zh: 4 月 10 日南延高雄可行性评估获核定；5 月 12 日淡江大桥通车。

events.en: The main line and Highway 9B around Taitung are swapped on 12 January.
events.zh: 1 月 12 日，台东一带台 9 线主线与台 9 乙线互换。

events.en: Storm washouts and a rockslide delay full reopening to 14 June, tying 1974 for the latest opening on record.
events.zh: 风暴冲毁与落石使全线恢复推迟至 6 月 14 日，与 1974 年并列有记录以来最晚开放。

events.en: Construction is scheduled to begin on the final SR 99 to SR 58 connector ramp in Bakersfield.
events.zh: 贝克斯菲尔德 SR 99 至 SR 58 最后一条连接匝道计划开工。

events.en: Construction of the replacement bridge is anticipated to begin.
events.zh: 替换桥梁预计开工。

events.en: The Tucker Hill Lane overpass in Bastrop County is anticipated to be complete.
events.zh: 巴斯特罗普县塔克山道跨线桥预计完工。

events.en: Widening and drainage work at the North Fork Matilija Creek Bridge is scheduled to finish.
events.zh: 北叉马蒂利哈溪大桥的加宽与排水工程计划完工。

events.en: That connector, and with it the Centennial Corridor, is scheduled for completion.
events.zh: 该连接匝道及整个百年走廊工程计划完工。
